translations.literal: Redundant troops should be cut; border officials should be clearly ordered to guard carefully and not create incidents — then distant peoples will submit.
translations.idiomatic: Redundant troops should be cut; border officials should be clearly ordered to guard carefully and not create incidents — then distant peoples will submit.

sentences.zh: 天下官田歲入，所以贍衛士，給戍卒。

translations.literal: The annual income from state fields under Heaven is to support guardsmen and supply garrison soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: The annual income from state fields empire-wide is meant to support guardsmen and supply garrison soldiers.

sentences.zh: 自至元三十一年以後，累朝以是田分賜諸王、公主、駙馬，及百官、宦者、寺觀之屬，遂令中書酬直海漕，虛耗國儲。

translations.literal: From the thirty-first year of Zhiyuan onward, successive reigns have used these fields as gifts to princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and officials, eunuchs, temples, and the like — causing the Secretariat to pay compensation for sea transport grain and emptying state reserves.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhiyuan 31 onward, successive reigns have granted these fields to princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, officials, eunuchs, temples, and the like — forcing the Secretariat to pay compensation for sea-transport grain and depleting state reserves.

sentences.zh: 其受田之家，各任土著姦吏為莊官，催甲鬥級，巧名多取；

translations.literal: The households receiving fields each employ native wicked clerks as estate managers, pressing village heads and tax captains and taking under crafty names;
translations.idiomatic: The households receiving these fields each employ native wicked clerks as estate managers, pressing village heads and tax captains and extracting extra levies under crafty names;

sentences.zh: 又且驅迫郵傳，徵求餼廩，折辱州縣，閉償逋負，至倉之日，變鬻以歸。

translations.literal: they also drive post stations, demand provisions, humiliate prefectures and counties, refuse to pay debts, and on the day grain reaches the granary change and sell it for their own return.
translations.idiomatic: they also press post stations, demand provisions, humiliate prefectures and counties, refuse to pay debts, and on the day grain reaches the granary divert and sell it for their own profit.

sentences.zh: 官司交忿，農民窘竄。

translations.literal: Offices exchange anger; peasants flee in distress.
translations.idiomatic: Offices exchange angry accusations; peasants flee in distress.

sentences.zh: 臣等議：惟諸王、公主、駙馬、寺觀，如所與公主桑哥剌吉及普安三寺之制，輸之公廩，計月直折支以鈔，令有司兼令輸之省部，給之大都；

translations.literal: We propose: for princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and temples only — as with Princess Sangge Laji and the three Pu'an temples — grain should be delivered to the public granary, monthly value calculated and paid in paper money, with the regular offices also ordered to deliver to the provincial department for supply to the Great Capital;
translations.idiomatic: We propose that for princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and temples only — as with Princess Sangge Laji and the three Pu'an temples — grain be delivered to the public granary, monthly value calculated and paid in paper money, with the regular offices also ordered to deliver to the provincial department for supply to the Great Capital;

sentences.zh: 其所賜百官及宦者之田，悉拘還官，著為令。

translations.literal: fields granted to officials and eunuchs should all be confiscated and returned to the state — and this should be established as law.
translations.idiomatic: and that fields granted to officials and eunuchs be confiscated and returned to the state — and that this be established as law.

sentences.zh: 國家經費，皆取​​於民。

translations.literal: State expenditure all comes from the people.
translations.idiomatic: State expenditure all comes from the people.

sentences.zh: 世祖時，淮北內地，惟輸丁稅，鐵木迭兒為相，專務聚斂，遣使括勘兩淮、河南田土，重並科糧；

translations.literal: In Shizu's time, in the inner lands north of the Huai, only poll tax was levied; when Temuder was chief minister he devoted himself to amassing revenue, sent envoys to survey and assess fields in the two Huai and Henan regions, and heavily merged grain tax;
translations.idiomatic: In Shizu's time, in the inner lands north of the Huai, only poll tax was levied. When Temuder was chief minister he devoted himself to amassing revenue, sent envoys to survey and assess fields in the two Huai and Henan regions, and heavily merged grain tax;

sentences.zh: 又以兩淮、荊襄沙磧作熟收徵，徼名興利，農民流徙。

translations.literal: he also taxed sandy and stony land in the two Huai and Jing-Xiang regions as if it were fertile, seeking profit under false names — peasants fled.
translations.idiomatic: he also taxed sandy and stony land in the two Huai and Jing-Xiang regions as if it were fertile, seeking profit under false pretenses — and peasants fled.

sentences.zh: 臣等議：宜如舊制，止徵丁稅，其括勘重並之糧，及沙磧不可田畝之稅，悉除之。

translations.literal: We propose: the old system should be followed — only poll tax levied; surveyed and merged grain tax, and tax on sandy stony land unsuitable for fields, should all be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: We propose that the old system be restored — only poll tax levied — and that surveyed and merged grain tax, and tax on sandy stony land unsuitable for cultivation, be abolished entirely.

sentences.zh: 世祖之制，凡有田者悉役之，民典賣田，隨收入戶。

translations.literal: Shizu's system: all who had fields were subject to corvée; when people mortgaged or sold fields, corvée followed entry into the household.
translations.idiomatic: Under Shizu's system, all who held fields were subject to corvée; when people mortgaged or sold fields, corvée followed entry into the new household.

sentences.zh: 鐵木迭兒為相，納江南諸寺賄賂，奏令僧人買民田者毋役之，以里正主首之屬，逮今流毒細民。

translations.literal: When Temuder was chief minister he accepted bribes from Jiangnan temples and memorialized that monks who bought commoners' fields should not be subject to corvée, with village heads and neighborhood chiefs — to this day poisoning the common people.
translations.idiomatic: When Temuder was chief minister he accepted bribes from Jiangnan temples and memorialized that monks who bought commoners' fields should be exempt from corvée, leaving village heads and neighborhood chiefs to bear the burden — a poison that afflicts the common people to this day.

sentences.zh: 臣等議：惟累朝所賜僧寺田及亡宋舊業，如舊制勿徵，其僧道典買民田及民間所施產業，宜悉役之，著為令。

translations.literal: We propose: only temple fields granted by successive reigns and old Song estates should, as in the old system, not be levied; monk and Daoist purchases of commoners' fields and property donated by the people should all be subject to corvée — and this should be established as law.
translations.idiomatic: We propose that only temple fields granted by successive reigns and old Song estates remain exempt as under the old system, but that monk and Daoist purchases of commoners' fields and property donated by the people be subject to corvée — and that this be established as law.

sentences.zh: 僧道出家，屏絕妻孥，蓋欲超出世表，是以國家優視，無所徭役，且處之官寺；

translations.literal: Monks and Daoists leave home and cut off wife and children, intending to rise above the world — therefore the state treats them favorably, exempts them from corvée, and places them in official temples;
translations.idiomatic: Monks and Daoists leave home and cut off ties to wife and children, intending to rise above the world — therefore the state treats them favorably, exempts them from corvée, and places them in official temples;

sentences.zh: 宜清淨絕俗為心，誦經祝壽。

translations.literal: they should take purity and withdrawal from the world as their heart, reciting sutras and praying for longevity.
translations.idiomatic: they should take purity and withdrawal from the world to heart, reciting sutras and praying for longevity.

sentences.zh: 比年僧道往往畜妻子，無異常人，如蔡道泰、班講主之徒，傷人逞欲、壞教幹刑者，何可勝數！

translations.literal: In recent years monks and Daoists often keep wives and children, no different from ordinary people — men such as Cai Daotai and Abbot Ban who injure others, indulge desires, and ruin the teaching while interfering with punishment — beyond counting!
translations.idiomatic: In recent years monks and Daoists often keep wives and children, no different from ordinary people — men such as Cai Daotai and Abbot Ban who injure others, indulge their desires, and ruin the teaching while interfering with the law — beyond counting!

sentences.zh: 俾奉祠典，豈不褻天瀆神！

translations.literal: To have them conduct sacrificial rites — would this not profane Heaven and insult the spirits!
translations.idiomatic: To have such men conduct sacrificial rites — would this not profane Heaven and insult the spirits!

sentences.zh: 臣等議：僧道之畜妻子者，宜罪以舊制，罷遣為民。

translations.literal: We propose: monks and Daoists who keep wives and children should be punished under the old system and dismissed to common status.
translations.idiomatic: We propose that monks and Daoists who keep wives and children be punished under the old system and dismissed to common status.

sentences.zh: 賞功勸善，人主大柄，豈宜輕以與人。

translations.literal: Rewarding merit and encouraging good are the great prerogatives of the ruler — they should not lightly be given to others.
translations.idiomatic: Rewarding merit and encouraging good are the great prerogatives of the ruler — they should not lightly be given away.

sentences.zh: 世祖臨御三十五年，左右之臣，雖甚愛幸，未聞無功而給一賞者。

translations.literal: In the thirty-five years Shizu held the throne, among the ministers at his side, however greatly favored, none was heard of receiving a reward without merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-five years Shizu held the throne, none of the ministers at his side, however greatly favored, received a reward without merit.

sentences.zh: 比年賞賜氾濫，蓋因近侍之人，窺伺天顏喜悅之際，或稱乏財無居，或稱嫁女取婦，或以枝物呈獻，殊無寸功小善，遞互奏請，要求賞賜回奉，奄有國家金銀珠玉，及斷沒人畜產業。

translations.literal: In recent years rewards and gifts have overflowed, mostly because palace favorites, watching for moments when Heaven's countenance was pleased, claimed lack of funds or housing, or marrying off daughters or taking wives, or presented branch objects — with not the slightest merit or small good — memorializing in turn, demanding reward and return gifts, until they possessed the state's gold, silver, pearls, jade, and confiscated people's livestock and property.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years rewards and gifts have overflowed, mostly because palace favorites, watching for moments when the emperor was pleased, claimed lack of funds or housing, or the need to marry off daughters or take wives, or presented trifling objects — with not the slightest merit — memorializing one after another and demanding rewards and return gifts until they possessed the state's gold, silver, pearls, jade, and confiscated people's livestock and property.

sentences.zh: 似此無功受賞，何以激勸，既傷財用，复啟幸門。

translations.literal: When reward is received without merit, how can effort be stirred; it both injures wealth and again opens the gate of favoritism.
translations.idiomatic: When men receive reward without merit, how can effort be stirred? It both wastes wealth and opens the gate of favoritism.

sentences.zh: 臣等議：非有功勳勞效著明實跡，不宜加以賞賜，乞著為令。

translations.literal: We propose: unless merit, achievement, and clear real traces are outstanding, reward should not be added; we beg this be established as law.
translations.idiomatic: We propose that unless merit, achievement, and clear real service are outstanding, no reward should be granted; we beg that this be established as law.

sentences.zh: 臣等所言：弒逆未討、奸惡未除、忠憤未雪、冤枉未理、政令不信、賞罰不公、賦役不均、財用不節、民怨神怒，皆足以感傷和氣。

translations.literal: What we have spoken: regicide not punished, wickedness not removed, loyal anger not redressed, wrongs not judged, government orders not trusted, rewards and punishments not fair, levies and corvée not equal, finances not restrained, people's resentment and spirits' anger — all sufficient to harm harmonious qi.
translations.idiomatic: What we have spoken of — regicide unpunished, wickedness unremoved, loyal outrage unredressed, wrongs unjudged, government orders untrusted, rewards and punishments unfair, levies and corvée unequal, finances unrestrained, the people's resentment and Heaven's anger — all are sufficient to harm the harmony of Heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 惟陛下裁擇，以答天意，消弭災變。

translations.literal: We ask Your Majesty to choose and decide, to answer Heaven's intent and dispel disasters and changes.
translations.idiomatic: We ask Your Majesty to choose and decide, to answer Heaven's intent and dispel disaster.

sentences.zh: 帝不從。

translations.literal: The Emperor did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not agree.

sentences.zh: 珪復進曰：「臣聞日食修德，月食修刑，應天以實不以文，動民以行不以言，刑政失平，故天象應之。

translations.literal: Gui again advanced and said: "Your subject has heard that at solar eclipse one cultivates virtue, at lunar eclipse one rectifies punishment; one responds to Heaven with reality not with words, moves the people with action not with speech — punishment and government lose balance, therefore Heaven's signs respond.
translations.idiomatic: Gui again advanced and said, "Your subject has heard that at a solar eclipse one cultivates virtue, and at a lunar eclipse one rectifies punishment. One responds to Heaven with deeds, not words, and moves the people with action, not speech. Punishment and government have lost balance, and therefore Heaven's signs respond.

sentences.zh: 惟陛下矜察，允臣等議，乞悉行之。

translations.literal: We ask Your Majesty to look with compassion and approve our proposals — we beg they all be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: We ask Your Majesty to look with compassion and approve our proposals — we beg that they all be carried out.

sentences.zh: 」帝終不能從。

translations.literal: " The Emperor in the end could not agree.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor in the end could not agree.

sentences.zh: 未幾，珪病增劇，非扶掖不能行。

translations.literal: Before long Gui's illness grew severe; without support he could not walk.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Gui's illness grew severe; without support he could not walk.

sentences.zh: 有詔：常見免拜跪，賜小車，得乘至殿門下。

translations.literal: An edict was issued: at regular audiences he was exempt from bowing and kneeling, given a small carriage, and permitted to ride to beneath the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued: at regular audiences he was exempt from bowing and kneeling, given a small carriage, and permitted to ride to the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 帝始開經筵，令左丞相與珪領之，珪進翰林學士吳澄等，以備顧問。

translations.literal: The Emperor first opened the Classics Lecture Hall and ordered the Left Grand Councilor and Gui to preside; Gui recommended Hanlin Academician Wu Cheng and others to serve as advisers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor first opened the Classics Lecture Hall and ordered the Left Grand Councilor and Gui to preside. Gui recommended Hanlin Academician Wu Cheng and others to serve as advisers.

sentences.zh: 自是辭位甚力，猶封蔡國公，知經筵事，別刻蔡國公印以賜。

translations.literal: From then on he resigned his post with great force, yet was still enfeoffed as Duke of Cai, charged with Classics Lecture affairs, and a separate Duke of Cai seal was carved and granted.
translations.idiomatic: From then on he pressed to resign with great force, yet was still enfeoffed as Duke of Cai, charged with Classics Lecture affairs, and a separate Duke of Cai seal was carved and granted.

sentences.zh: 泰定二年夏，得旨暫歸。

translations.literal: In summer of the second year of Taiding he received permission to return home temporarily.
translations.idiomatic: In summer of Taiding 2 he received permission to return home temporarily.

sentences.zh: ○李孟

translations.literal: Li Meng
translations.idiomatic: Li Meng

sentences.zh: 李孟，字道复，潞州上黨人。

translations.literal: Li Meng, style name Daofu, was a man of Shangdang in Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Meng, courtesy name Daofu, was a native of Shangdang in Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 曾祖執，金末舉進士。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Zhi passed the jinshi examination at the end of the Jin.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Zhi passed the jinshi examination at the end of the Jin dynasty.

sentences.zh: 祖昌祚，歸朝，授金符、潞州宣撫使。

translations.literal: His grandfather Changzuo submitted to the dynasty and was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Luzhou with a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Changzuo submitted to the dynasty and was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Luzhou with a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 父唐，歷仕秦、蜀，因徙居漢中。

translations.literal: His father Tang served through Qin and Shu and therefore moved to live in Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tang served in Qin and Shu and therefore moved to live in Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 孟生而敏悟，七歲能文，倜儻有大志，博學強記，通貫經史，善論古今治亂，開門授徒，遠近爭從之。

translations.literal: Meng was born quick and perceptive; at seven he could write; he was unconventional with great ambition, learned and strong in memory, thoroughly versed in the classics and histories, skilled at discussing the rise and fall of governance ancient and modern; he opened his door to teach disciples and men near and far competed to follow him.
translations.idiomatic: Meng was born quick and perceptive. At seven he could write. Unconventional and ambitious, he was learned and possessed a powerful memory, thoroughly versed in the classics and histories and skilled at discussing the rise and fall of governance through the ages. He opened his door to teach disciples, and men near and far competed to follow him.

sentences.zh: 一時名人商挺、王博文，皆折行輩與交。

translations.literal: At the time famous men Shang Ting and Wang Bowen both lowered their seniority to associate with him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time famous men Shang Ting and Wang Bowen both lowered their seniority to associate with him.

sentences.zh: 郭彥通名能知人，嘗語唐曰：「此兒骨相異常，宰輔之器也。

translations.literal: Guo Yantong was famed for knowing men; he once said to Tang: "This boy's bone structure is extraordinary — he has the vessel of a chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Yantong was famed for knowing men. He once said to Tang, "This boy's bone structure is extraordinary — he has the makings of a chief minister.

sentences.zh: 」至元十四年，隨父入蜀，行省辟為掾，不赴；

translations.literal: " In the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan he followed his father into Shu; the branch secretariat recruited him as clerk — he did not go;
translations.idiomatic: " In Zhiyuan 14 he followed his father into Shu. The branch secretariat recruited him as a clerk — he did not go.

sentences.zh: 調晉原縣主簿，又辭；

translations.literal: he was transferred to be chief clerk of Jinyuan County and again declined;
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to be chief clerk of Jinyuan County and again declined.

sentences.zh: 行御史臺交薦之，亦不就。

translations.literal: the Branch Censorate jointly recommended him — he still did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: The Branch Censorate jointly recommended him — he still did not accept.

sentences.zh: 後以事至京師，中書右丞楊吉丁一見奇之，薦於裕宗，得召見東宮。

translations.literal: Later when business brought him to the capital, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Yang Jiding, seeing him once, found him extraordinary and recommended him to Yuzong; he was summoned to audience in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when business brought him to the capital, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Yang Jiding found him extraordinary at a single meeting and recommended him to Yuzong. He was summoned to audience in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 未幾，裕宗薨，不及擢用。

translations.literal: Before long Yuzong died and there was no time to promote him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yuzong died, and there was no time to promote him.

sentences.zh: 成宗立，首命採訪先朝聖政，以備史官之紀述，陝西省使孟討論編次，乘驛以進。

translations.literal: When Chengzong ascended he first ordered collection of the sage policies of the former reign to supply the historians' record; the Shaanxi Branch envoy Meng discussed and compiled them and rushed them by post relay to present them.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong ascended the throne he first ordered the collection of the sage policies of the former reign to supply the historians' record. The Shaanxi Branch envoy Meng discussed and compiled them and rushed them by post relay to present them.

sentences.zh: 時武宗、仁宗皆未出閣​​，徽仁裕聖皇后求名儒輔導，有薦者曰：「布衣李孟有宰相才，宜令為太子師傅。

translations.literal: At the time Wuzong and Renzong had not yet left the palace; Empress Huiren Yusheng sought famous Confucians to instruct them; a recommender said: "The commoner Li Meng has the talent of a chief minister — he should be made tutor to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Wuzong and Renzong had not yet left the palace. Empress Huiren Yusheng sought famous Confucians to instruct them. A recommender said, "The commoner Li Meng has the talent of a chief minister — he should be made tutor to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 」大德元年，武宗撫軍北方，仁宗留宮中，孟日陳善言正道，多所進益。

translations.literal: " In the first year of Dade, Wuzong commanded armies in the north while Renzong remained in the palace; Meng daily set forth good words and the straight Way, greatly benefiting him.
translations.idiomatic: " In Dade 1, Wuzong commanded armies in the north while Renzong remained in the palace. Meng daily set forth good words and the straight Way, greatly benefiting him.

sentences.zh: 成宗聞而嘉之，詔授​​太常少卿，執政以孟未嘗一造其門，沮之不行，改禮部侍郎，命亦中止。

translations.literal: Chengzong heard and praised this; an edict was issued appointing Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices — the chief ministers, because Meng had never once visited their doors, obstructed it and it did not proceed; it was changed to Vice Minister of Rites — that order also stopped midway.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong heard and praised this. An edict was issued appointing him Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices — but the chief ministers, because Meng had never once visited their doors, obstructed it and the appointment did not proceed. It was changed to Vice Minister of Rites — that order also stopped midway.

sentences.zh: 仁宗侍昭獻元聖皇后降居懷州，又如官山，孟常單騎以從。

translations.literal: When Renzong attended Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng in retirement at Huaizhou, and again at Guanshan, Meng often followed alone on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong attended Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng in retirement at Huaizhou, and again at Guanshan, Meng often followed alone on horseback.

sentences.zh: 在懷州四年，誠節如一，左右化之，皆有儒雅風，由是上下益親。

translations.literal: At Huaizhou for four years his sincerity and constancy were one; those around him were transformed and all had a scholarly air — thereby superiors and inferiors grew ever closer.
translations.idiomatic: At Huaizhou for four years his sincerity and constancy never wavered. Those around him were transformed and all acquired a scholarly air — and thereby superiors and inferiors grew ever closer.

sentences.zh: 每進言曰：「堯、舜之道，孝悌而已矣。

translations.literal: Each time he advanced words he said: "The Way of Yao and Shun is filial piety and brotherly duty, nothing more.
translations.idiomatic: Each time he offered counsel he said, "The Way of Yao and Shun is filial piety and brotherly duty, nothing more.

sentences.zh: 今大兄在朔方，大母有居外之憂，殿下當迎奉意旨以娛樂之，則孝悌之道皆得矣。

translations.literal: Now the elder brother is in the north and the Grand Empress has the worry of living abroad — Your Highness should welcome and follow her intent to give her joy — then the Way of filial piety and brotherly duty will both be attained.
translations.idiomatic: Now the elder brother is in the north and the Grand Empress has the worry of living abroad. Your Highness should welcome and follow her intent to give her joy — then the Way of filial piety and brotherly duty will both be attained.

sentences.zh: 」仁宗深納其言，日問安視膳，婉容愉色，天下稱孝焉。

translations.literal: " Renzong deeply accepted his words; daily he inquired after her health and attended her meals with gentle countenance and pleased expression — all under Heaven called it filial.
translations.idiomatic: " Renzong deeply accepted his words. Daily he inquired after her health and attended her meals with gentle countenance and pleased expression — and all under Heaven called it filial.

sentences.zh: 有暇，則就孟講論古先帝王得失成敗，及君君臣臣父父子子之義。

translations.literal: When he had leisure he would go to Meng to discuss the gains and losses, success and failure of ancient emperors, and the meaning of ruler and subject, father and son.
translations.idiomatic: When he had leisure he would go to Meng to discuss the gains and losses, success and failure of ancient emperors, and the meaning of ruler and subject, father and son.

sentences.zh: 孟特善論事，忠愛懇惻，言之不厭，而治天下之大經大法，深切明白。

translations.literal: Meng was especially skilled at discussing affairs — loyal, loving, earnest and sincere; he spoke without wearying — and the great norms and laws for governing the world were deeply clear and plain.
translations.idiomatic: Meng was especially skilled at discussing affairs — loyal, loving, earnest and sincere, speaking without wearying — and the great norms and laws for governing the world were deeply clear and plain.

sentences.zh: 厥後仁宗入清內難，敬事武皇，篤孝母后，端拱以成太平之功，文物典章，號為極盛。

translations.literal: Thereafter when Renzong entered to settle the inner crisis, reverently served the Martial Emperor, deeply filial to the Empress Dowager, and sat upright to complete the achievement of great peace — culture, rites, and institutions were called at their height.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, when Renzong entered to settle the inner crisis, reverently served the Martial Emperor, was deeply filial to the Empress Dowager, and sat upright to complete the achievement of great peace — culture, rites, and institutions were said to be at their height.

sentences.zh: 嘗與群臣語，握拳示之曰：「所重乎儒者，為其握持綱常，如此其固也。

translations.literal: Once speaking with his ministers he clenched his fist and showed it to them, saying: "What is valued in the Confucian is that he holds fast to the constant norms — as firm as this.
translations.idiomatic: Once, speaking with his ministers, he clenched his fist and showed it to them, saying, "What is valued in the Confucian is that he holds fast to the constant norms — as firm as this.

sentences.zh: 」其講學之功如此者，實孟啟之也。

translations.literal: " That his achievement in lecturing was such — Meng truly opened it.
translations.idiomatic: " That his achievement in lecturing was such — Meng truly opened the way.

sentences.zh: 成宗崩，安西王阿難答謀繼大統，成後為之主，丞相、樞密同聲附和。

translations.literal: When Chengzong died, Prince Anxi Ananda plotted to succeed to the great succession; Empress Cheng was his patron; the chief minister and Bureau of Military Affairs echoed in agreement.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong died, Prince Anxi Ananda plotted to succeed to the throne. Empress Cheng was his patron, and the chief minister and Bureau of Military Affairs echoed in agreement.

sentences.zh: 中書右丞相哈剌哈孫答剌罕密使來告，仁宗疑而未行。

translations.literal: Right Grand Councilor Hala Hasan Dalaqan secretly sent word; Renzong was suspicious and did not act.
translations.idiomatic: Right Grand Councilor Hala Hasan Dalaqan secretly sent word. Renzong was suspicious and did not act.

sentences.zh: 孟曰：「支子不嗣，世祖之典訓也。

translations.literal: Meng said: "A collateral son does not succeed — this is Shizu's canonical instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Meng said, "A collateral son does not succeed — this is Shizu's canonical instruction.

sentences.zh: 今宮車晏駕，大太子遠在萬里，宗廟社稷危疑之秋，殿下當奉大母，急還宮庭，以折奸謀、固人心。

translations.literal: Now the imperial carriage has halted and the elder crown prince is ten thousand li distant — in this autumn of crisis for the ancestral temple and state altar, Your Highness should attend the Grand Empress and hurry back to the palace to break wicked plots and firm the people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Now the imperial carriage has halted and the elder crown prince is ten thousand li distant. In this autumn of crisis for the ancestral temple and state altar, Your Highness should attend the Grand Empress and hurry back to the palace to break wicked plots and firm the people's hearts.

sentences.zh: 不然，國家安危，未可保也。

translations.literal: Otherwise the state's safety cannot be guaranteed.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise the state's safety cannot be guaranteed.

sentences.zh: 」仁宗猶豫未決。

translations.literal: " Renzong still hesitated and did not decide.
translations.idiomatic: " Renzong still hesitated and did not decide.

sentences.zh: 孟復進曰：「邪謀得成，以一紙書召還，則殿下母子且不自保，豈暇論宗族乎！

translations.literal: Meng again advanced and said: "If the wicked plot succeeds, a summons on a sheet of paper will recall you — then Your Highness and your mother cannot even preserve yourselves, how can there be leisure to discuss the clan!
translations.idiomatic: Meng again advanced and said, "If the wicked plot succeeds, a summons on a sheet of paper will recall you — then Your Highness and your mother cannot even preserve yourselves. How can there be leisure to discuss the clan!

sentences.zh: 」仁宗悅，曰：「先生之言，宗廟社稷之福。

translations.literal: " Renzong was pleased and said: "The Master's words are the blessing of the ancestral temple and state altar.
translations.idiomatic: " Renzong was pleased and said, "The Master's words are the blessing of the ancestral temple and state altar.

sentences.zh: 」乃奉太后還都。

translations.literal: " He then attended the Empress Dowager in returning to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: " He then attended the Empress Dowager in returning to the capital.

sentences.zh: 時哈剌哈孫稱病堅臥，仁宗遣孟往問之，適成後使人問疾，絡繹不絕。

translations.literal: At the time Hala Hasan claimed illness and lay abed; Renzong sent Meng to inquire of him — just as Empress Cheng's envoys came to ask after his illness, one after another without pause.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Hala Hasan claimed illness and lay abed. Renzong sent Meng to inquire of him — just as Empress Cheng's envoys came to ask after his illness, one after another without pause.

sentences.zh: 孟入，長揖而坐，已而前引其手，診其脈，眾以為醫，乃不疑之。

translations.literal: Meng entered, bowed with hands joined and sat; then he stepped forward and took his hand, feeling his pulse — the crowd thought him a physician and therefore did not suspect.
translations.idiomatic: Meng entered, bowed with hands joined and sat. Then he stepped forward and took Hala Hasan's hand, feeling his pulse — the crowd thought him a physician and therefore did not suspect.

sentences.zh: 既得知安西王即位有日，還告曰：「事急矣！

translations.literal: Having learned that Prince Anxi's enthronement was set for a date, he returned and reported: "The affair is urgent!
translations.idiomatic: Having learned that Prince Anxi's enthronement was set for a date, he returned and reported, "The affair is urgent!

sentences.zh: 先發者制人，後發者制於人，不可不早圖之。

translations.literal: He who strikes first controls others; he who strikes later is controlled by others — this cannot but be planned early.
translations.idiomatic: He who strikes first controls others; he who strikes later is controlled by others — this must be planned early.

sentences.zh: 」左右之人皆不能決，惟曲出、伯鐵木兒勸其行。

translations.literal: " Those around could none decide — only Quchu and Bo Temur urged him to act.
translations.idiomatic: " Those around could none decide — only Quchu and Bo Temur urged him to act.

sentences.zh: 或曰：「皇后深居九重，八璽在手，四衛之士，一呼而應者累萬；

translations.literal: Someone said: "The Empress dwells deep within the nine layers; the eight seals are in her hand; the four guards' soldiers — at one call tens of thousands respond;
translations.idiomatic: Someone said, "The Empress dwells deep within the nine layers of the palace. The eight seals are in her hand. The four guards' soldiers — at one call tens of thousands respond.

sentences.zh: 安西王府中從者如林。

translations.literal: followers in Prince Anxi's palace are like a forest.
translations.idiomatic: Followers in Prince Anxi's palace are like a forest.

sentences.zh: 殿下侍衛寡弱，不過數十人，兵仗不備，奮赤手而往，事未必濟。

translations.literal: Your Highness's guard is weak and few — no more than several tens; weapons are not prepared; to rush with bare hands — the affair may not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Your Highness's guard is weak and few — no more than several tens. Weapons are not prepared. To rush in with bare hands — the affair may not succeed.

sentences.zh: 不如靜守，以俟阿合之至，然後圖之，未晚也。

translations.literal: Better to wait quietly for Aqa's arrival, then plan — it would not be late.
translations.idiomatic: Better to wait quietly for Aqa's arrival, then plan — it would not be too late.

sentences.zh: 」阿合，中國稱兄，謂武宗也。

translations.literal: " Aqa — in Chinese called elder brother — means Wuzong.
translations.idiomatic: " Aqa — in Chinese called elder brother — means Wuzong.

sentences.zh: 孟曰：「群邪違棄祖訓，黨附中宮，欲立庶子，天命人心，必皆弗與。

translations.literal: Meng said: "The wicked multitude abandon the ancestral instruction, clinging to the inner palace, wishing to establish a lesser son — Heaven's mandate and the people's hearts will surely not give it to them.
translations.idiomatic: Meng said, "The wicked multitude abandon the ancestral instruction, clinging to the inner palace, wishing to establish a lesser son — Heaven's mandate and the people's hearts will surely not give it to them.

sentences.zh: 殿下入造內庭，以大義責之，則凡知君臣之義者，無不捨彼為殿下用，何求而弗獲！

translations.literal: If Your Highness enters the inner court and rebukes them with great principle, then all who know the meaning of ruler and subject will without exception abandon them to serve Your Highness — what could you seek and not obtain!
translations.idiomatic: If Your Highness enters the inner court and rebukes them with great principle, then all who know the meaning of ruler and subject will without exception abandon them to serve Your Highness — what could you seek and not obtain!

sentences.zh: 克清宮禁，以迎大兄之至，不亦可乎！

translations.literal: Clear the palace and welcome the elder brother's arrival — is this not also fitting!
translations.idiomatic: Clear the palace and welcome the elder brother's arrival — is this not also fitting!

sentences.zh: 且安西既正位號，縱大太子至，彼安肯兩手進璽，退就籓國；

translations.literal: Moreover, once Anxi has taken the throne, even if the elder crown prince arrives, how would he willingly offer the seal with both hands and withdraw to his fief;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, once Anxi has taken the throne, even if the elder crown prince arrives, how would he willingly offer the seal with both hands and withdraw to his fief?

sentences.zh: 必將鬥於國中，生民塗炭，宗社危矣。

translations.literal: surely they will fight within the state, the people smeared with blood, the ancestral temple endangered.
translations.idiomatic: Surely they will fight within the state, the people smeared with blood, and the ancestral temple endangered.

sentences.zh: 且危身以及其親，非孝也；

translations.literal: To endanger oneself and reach one's kin — this is not filial;
translations.idiomatic: To endanger oneself and reach one's kin — this is not filial;

sentences.zh: 遺禍難於大兄，非悌也；

translations.literal: to leave disaster for the elder brother — this is not brotherly;
translations.idiomatic: to leave disaster for the elder brother — this is not brotherly;

sentences.zh: 得時弗為，非智也；

translations.literal: to obtain the moment and not act — this is not wise;
translations.idiomatic: to obtain the moment and not act — this is not wise;

sentences.zh: 臨機不斷，無勇也。

translations.literal: at the critical moment not to decide — this is not brave.
translations.idiomatic: at the critical moment not to decide — this is not brave.

sentences.zh: 仗義而動，事必萬全。

translations.literal: To move upholding righteousness — the affair will surely be ten thousand times secure.
translations.idiomatic: To move upholding righteousness — the affair will surely succeed completely.

sentences.zh: 」仁宗曰：「當以卜決之。

translations.literal: " Renzong said: "Let it be decided by divination.
translations.idiomatic: " Renzong said, "Let it be decided by divination.

sentences.zh: 」命召卜人，有儒服持囊遊於市者，召之至，孟出迎，語之曰：「大事待汝而決，但言其吉。

translations.literal: " He ordered a diviner summoned; there was one in Confucian dress carrying a bag wandering in the market — summoned to come; Meng went out to meet him and said: "A great affair waits on you to decide — only speak that it is auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered a diviner summoned. There was one in Confucian dress carrying a bag wandering in the market — summoned to come. Meng went out to meet him and said, "A great affair waits on you to decide — only speak that it is auspicious.

sentences.zh: 」乃入筮，遇乾三五皆九，立而獻卦曰：「是謂乾之睽。

translations.literal: " He then entered to divine; encountering Qian with three and five all nines, he stood and presented the hexagram saying: "This is called Qian changing to Kui.
translations.idiomatic: " He then entered to divine. Encountering Qian with three and five all nines, he stood and presented the hexagram, saying, "This is called Qian changing to Kui.

sentences.zh: 乾，剛也；

translations.literal: Qian — firm;
translations.idiomatic: Qian — firm;

sentences.zh: 睽，外也。

translations.literal: Kui — outer.
translations.idiomatic: Kui — outer.

sentences.zh: 以剛處外，乃定內也。

translations.literal: With firmness placed outside, the inner is thereby settled.
translations.idiomatic: With firmness placed outside, the inner is thereby settled.

sentences.zh: 君子乾乾，行事也。

translations.literal: The noble person qian qian — acting in affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The noble person qian qian — acting in affairs.

sentences.zh: 飛龍在天，上治也。

translations.literal: The flying dragon in Heaven — governing above.
translations.idiomatic: The flying dragon in Heaven — governing above.

sentences.zh: 輿曳牛掣，其人耏且劓，內兌廢也。

translations.literal: The cart drags, the ox pulls — that man is mutilated and nose-cut; inner joy is overthrown.
translations.idiomatic: The cart drags, the ox pulls — that man is mutilated and nose-cut; inner joy is overthrown.

sentences.zh: 厥宗筮膚，往必濟也。

translations.literal: His clan's divination reaches the skin — going forth will surely succeed.
translations.idiomatic: His clan's divination reaches the skin — going forth will surely succeed.

sentences.zh: 大君外至，明相麗也。

translations.literal: The great lord arrives from without; the bright minister is attached.
translations.idiomatic: The great lord arrives from without; the bright minister is attached.

sentences.zh: 乾而不乾，事乃睽也；

translations.literal: Qian yet not qian — affairs thereby kui;
translations.idiomatic: Qian yet not qian — affairs thereby kui;

sentences.zh: 剛運善斷，無惑疑也。

translations.literal: firm movement with good decision — without confusion or doubt.
translations.idiomatic: firm movement with good decision — without confusion or doubt.

sentences.zh: 」孟曰：「筮不違人，是謂大同，時不可以失。

translations.literal: " Meng said: "Divination does not oppose men — this is called great accord; the moment cannot be lost.
translations.idiomatic: " Meng said, "Divination does not oppose men — this is called great accord. The moment cannot be lost.

sentences.zh: 」仁宗喜，振袖而起，乃共扶上馬，孟及諸臣皆步從，入自延春門。

translations.literal: " Renzong rejoiced, shook his sleeves and rose; they together helped him mount; Meng and the ministers all walked following; they entered by the Yanchun Gate.
translations.idiomatic: " Renzong rejoiced, shook his sleeves and rose. They together helped him mount. Meng and the ministers all walked following. They entered by the Yanchun Gate.

sentences.zh: 哈剌哈孫自東掖來就之，至殿廊，收首謀及同惡者，悉送都獄；

translations.literal: Hala Hasan came from the east side to join them; reaching the palace corridor, the chief plotters and their accomplices were all sent to the capital prison;
translations.idiomatic: Hala Hasan came from the east side to join them. Reaching the palace corridor, the chief plotters and their accomplices were all sent to the capital prison.

sentences.zh: 奉御璽，北迎武宗，中外翕然，隨以定。

translations.literal: the imperial seal was secured and Wuzong was welcomed from the north; inner and outer were united and the realm was thereby settled.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial seal was secured and Wuzong was welcomed from the north. Inner and outer were united and the realm was thereby settled.

sentences.zh: 仁宗監國，使孟參知政事。

translations.literal: Renzong supervised the state and made Meng Associate Administrator of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong supervised the state and made Meng Associate Administrator of Affairs.

sentences.zh: 孟久在民間，備知閭閻幽隱，損益庶務，悉中利病，遠近無不悅服，然特抑絕僥倖，群小多不樂，孟不為變。

translations.literal: Meng had long been among the people and fully knew the hidden grievances of lanes and alleys; in improving and cutting various affairs he all hit profit and harm — near and far none were not pleased and submitted; yet he especially cut off opportunists — the petty many were displeased; Meng did not change for them.
translations.idiomatic: Meng had long lived among the people and fully knew the hidden grievances of lanes and alleys. In improving and cutting various affairs he always hit the mark — near and far, none failed to be pleased and submit. Yet he especially cut off opportunists — the petty many were displeased, but Meng did not change for them.

sentences.zh: 事定，乃言於仁宗曰：「執政大臣，當自天子親用，今鸞輿在道，孟未見顏色，誠不敢冒當重任。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled he then spoke to Renzong saying: "Chief ministers of government should be personally used by the Son of Heaven; now the imperial carriage is on the road — Meng has not seen his countenance — truly he dares not rashly undertake heavy responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled he then spoke to Renzong, saying, "Chief ministers of government should be personally appointed by the Son of Heaven. Now the imperial carriage is on the road — Meng has not seen his countenance — truly he dares not rashly undertake heavy responsibility.

sentences.zh: 」固辭弗許，遂逃去，不知所之。

translations.literal: " He firmly declined but was not permitted; he then fled — none knew where.
translations.idiomatic: " He firmly declined but was not permitted. He then fled — none knew where.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，武宗即位，有言於帝曰：「內難之初定也，李孟嘗勸皇弟以自取，如彼言，豈有今日！

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer Wuzong ascended the throne; someone spoke to the Emperor saying: "At the beginning of the inner crisis's settlement, Li Meng once urged the imperial younger brother to take it for himself — if he had followed that word, how could there be today!
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer Wuzong ascended the throne. Someone spoke to the emperor, saying, "At the beginning of the inner crisis's settlement, Li Meng once urged the imperial younger brother to take the throne for himself — if he had followed that word, how could there be today!

sentences.zh: 」武宗察其誣，弗聽，仁宗亦不敢復言孟。

translations.literal: " Wuzong saw the slander and did not listen; Renzong also dared not again speak of Meng.
translations.idiomatic: " Wuzong saw the slander and did not listen. Renzong also dared not again speak of Meng.

sentences.zh: 至大二年，仁宗為皇太子，嘗侍帝同太后內宴，飲半，仁宗深思，戚然改容。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhidai, Renzong was crown prince; once attending the Emperor with the Empress Dowager at an inner banquet, when the drinking was half done Renzong thought deeply and his expression changed to sorrow.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidai 2, Renzong was crown prince. Once, attending the emperor with the Empress Dowager at an inner banquet, when the drinking was half done Renzong thought deeply and his expression changed to sorrow.

sentences.zh: 帝顧語曰：「吾弟今日不樂，何所思邪？

translations.literal: The Emperor turned and said: "My younger brother is unhappy today — what is he thinking?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor turned and said, "My younger brother is unhappy today — what is he thinking?

sentences.zh: 」仁宗從容起謝曰：」賴天地祖宗神靈，神器有歸，然成今日母子兄弟之歡者，李道復之功為多。

translations.literal: " Renzong calmly rose and thanked him: "Relying on the spirits of Heaven, Earth, and the ancestors, the sacred vessel has found its place — yet of those who made today's joy of mother, son, and brothers, Li Daofu's achievement is greatest.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong calmly rose and thanked him, saying, "Relying on the spirits of Heaven, Earth, and the ancestors, the sacred vessel has found its place — yet of those who made today's joy of mother, son, and brothers, Li Daofu's achievement is greatest.

sentences.zh: 適有所思，不自知其變於色也。

translations.literal: Just now I was thinking — I did not know my expression had changed.
translations.idiomatic: I was just thinking — I did not know my expression had changed.

sentences.zh: 」帝甚友愛，感其言，即命搜訪之，得之許昌陘山，遣使召之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor was very affectionate, moved by his words, and immediately ordered a search; he was found at Xuchang on Mount Sheng, and an envoy was sent to summon him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was deeply affectionate, moved by his words, and immediately ordered a search. Meng was found at Xuchang on Mount Sheng, and an envoy was sent to summon him.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月，入見武宗於玉德殿，帝指孟謂宰執大臣曰：「此皇祖妣命為朕賓師者，宜速任之。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the third year he entered audience with Wuzong at the Yude Hall; the Emperor pointed to Meng and said to the chief ministers: "This is he whom the Grand Empress of the Imperial Ancestor ordered as guest and teacher for Us — he should quickly be appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the third year he entered audience with Wuzong at the Yude Hall. The emperor pointed to Meng and said to the chief ministers, "This is he whom the Grand Empress of the Imperial Ancestor ordered as guest and teacher for me — he should quickly be appointed.

sentences.zh: 」三月，特授榮祿大夫、中書平章政事、集賢大學士，同知徽政院事。

translations.literal: " In the third month he was specially appointed Grand Master for Glorious Blessing, Grand Councilor of the Secretariat, Grand Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, and Associate Director of the Huizheng Court.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he was specially appointed Grand Master for Glorious Blessing, Grand Councilor of the Secretariat, Grand Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, and Associate Director of the Huizheng Court.

sentences.zh: 仁宗嗣立，真拜中書平章政事，進階光祿大夫，推恩其三世，且諭之曰：「卿，朕之舊學，其盡心以輔朕之不及。

translations.literal: When Renzong succeeded he was formally appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat, promoted to Grand Master of Brilliant Blessing, honors extended to three generations of his family, and he was told: "You, Our old teacher — exert your heart to assist where We fall short.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong succeeded he was formally appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat, promoted to Grand Master of Brilliant Blessing, with honors extended to three generations of his family. The emperor told him, "You are my old teacher — exert your heart to assist where I fall short.

sentences.zh: 」孟感知遇，力以國事為己任，節賜與，重名爵，核太官之濫費，汰宿衛之冗員。

translations.literal: " Meng, feeling the grace shown him, devoted his strength to state affairs as his own duty — restraining gifts, weighting titles and ranks, auditing the Grand Provisioner's wasteful spending, and cutting redundant members of the imperial guard.
translations.idiomatic: Meng, feeling the grace shown him, devoted himself to state affairs — restraining gifts, weighting titles and ranks, auditing the Grand Provisioner's wasteful spending, and cutting redundant members of the imperial guard.

sentences.zh: 貴戚近臣，惡其不便於己，而心服其公，無間言焉。

translations.literal: Noble kin and palace favorites hated that it was inconvenient for themselves, yet in their hearts submitted to his fairness and had no dissenting words.
translations.idiomatic: Noble kin and palace favorites hated that his reforms were inconvenient for themselves, yet in their hearts they submitted to his fairness and had no dissenting words.

sentences.zh: 司空、司徒、太尉，古之三公，自大德以來，封拜繁多；

translations.literal: Minister of Works, Minister over the Masses, and Grand Marshal — the three dukes of antiquity — since Dade, enfeoffments and appointments have been numerous;
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works, Minister over the Masses, and Grand Marshal — the three dukes of antiquity — since Dade, enfeoffments and appointments have been numerous;

sentences.zh: 釋、老二教，設官統治，權抗有司，撓亂政事，僧道尤苦其擾。

translations.literal: the two teachings of Buddhism and Daoism established offices to govern, their authority rivaling the regular offices, disturbing government affairs — monks and Daoists especially suffered from the disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: the two teachings of Buddhism and Daoism established offices to govern, their authority rivaling the regular offices and disturbing government affairs — monks and Daoists especially suffered from the disturbance.

sentences.zh: 孟言：「人君之柄，在賞與刑，賞一善而天下勸，罰一惡而天下懲，柄乃不失。

translations.literal: Meng said: "The ruler's handle lies in reward and punishment — reward one good and all under Heaven are encouraged; punish one evil and all under Heaven are chastened — then the handle is not lost.
translations.idiomatic: Meng said, "The ruler's handle lies in reward and punishment — reward one good deed and all under Heaven are encouraged; punish one evil and all under Heaven are chastened — then the handle is not lost.

sentences.zh: 所施失當，不足勸懲，何以為治！

translations.literal: When what is applied is not fitting, insufficient to encourage or chasten — how can there be governance!
translations.idiomatic: When what is applied is not fitting, insufficient to encourage or chasten — how can there be governance!

sentences.zh: 僧、道士既為出世法，何用官府繩治！

translations.literal: Monks and Daoist masters, having the law of leaving the world — why use government offices to bind and govern them!
translations.idiomatic: Monks and Daoist masters follow the law of leaving the world — why use government offices to bind and govern them!

sentences.zh: 」乃奏雪冤死者，復其官廕；

translations.literal: " He then memorialized to clear the wrongfully dead, restoring their official privileges;
translations.idiomatic: He then memorialized to clear the wrongfully dead, restoring their official privileges;

sentences.zh: 濫冒名爵者，悉奪之；

translations.literal: those who falsely usurped titles and ranks — all were stripped;
translations.idiomatic: those who falsely usurped titles and ranks were all stripped;

sentences.zh: 罷僧道官。

translations.literal: monk and Daoist offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: monk and Daoist offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 天下稱快。

translations.literal: All under Heaven rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: All under Heaven rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 仁宗初出居懷，深見吏弊，欲痛剷除之。

translations.literal: When Renzong first went out to live at Huai he deeply saw the abuses of clerks and wished to cut them away with pain.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong first went out to live at Huai he deeply saw the abuses of clerks and wished to cut them away root and branch.

sentences.zh: 孟進言曰：「吏亦有賢者，在乎變化激厲之而已。

translations.literal: Meng advanced and said: "Among clerks too there are worthy men — it lies in transforming and spurring them.
translations.idiomatic: Meng advanced and said, "Among clerks too there are worthy men — it lies in transforming and spurring them.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「卿儒者，宜與此曹氣類不合，而曲相護祐如此，真長者之言。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "You are a Confucian — you ought not to be of the same temper as this crowd, yet you bend to protect them thus — truly the words of an elder.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "You are a Confucian — you ought not to be of the same temper as this crowd, yet you bend to protect them thus — truly the words of an elder.

sentences.zh: 卿在朕前，惟舉人所長，而不斥其短，尤朕所深嘉也。

translations.literal: Before Us you only raise men's strengths and do not expose their weaknesses — this We especially deeply praise.
translations.idiomatic: Before me you only raise men's strengths and do not expose their weaknesses — this I especially praise.

sentences.zh: 」時承平日久，風俗奢靡，車服僭擬，上下無章，近臣恃恩，求請無厭。

translations.literal: " At the time long peace had made customs extravagant; carriage and dress usurped rank; superiors and inferiors had no distinction; palace favorites relied on favor and their requests knew no end.
translations.idiomatic: At the time long peace had made customs extravagant. Carriage and dress usurped rank; superiors and inferiors had no distinction; palace favorites relied on favor and their requests knew no end.

sentences.zh: 時宰不為裁制，乃更相汲引，望幸恩賜，耗竭公儲，以為私惠。

translations.literal: The chief ministers did not restrain them but instead mutually recommended one another, hoping for favor and gifts, draining public reserves to make private kindness.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers did not restrain them but instead mutually recommended one another, hoping for favor and gifts, draining public reserves to make private kindness.

sentences.zh: 孟言：「貴賤有章，所以定民志；

translations.literal: Meng said: "Noble and base have distinction — this is how to fix the people's will;
translations.idiomatic: Meng said, "Noble and base must have distinction — this is how to fix the people's will;

sentences.zh: 賜與有節，所以勸臣下。

translations.literal: gifts and grants have measure — this is how to encourage ministers.
translations.idiomatic: gifts and grants must have measure — this is how to encourage ministers.

sentences.zh: 請各為之限制。

translations.literal: We ask that limits be set for each.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that limits be set for each.

sentences.zh: 」帝皆從之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor all followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed all of this.

sentences.zh: 孟在政府，雖多所補益，而自視常若不及，嘗因間請曰：「臣學聖人道，遭遇陛下，陛下堯、舜之主也。

translations.literal: Meng in government, though he benefited much, yet in his own view always seemed insufficient; once taking an interval he requested: "Your subject studied the sage's Way and encountered Your Majesty — Your Majesty is a Yao-Shun ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Meng in government, though he benefited much, yet in his own view always seemed insufficient. Once, taking an interval, he requested, "Your subject studied the sage's Way and encountered Your Majesty — Your Majesty is a Yao-Shun ruler.

sentences.zh: 臣不能使天下為堯、舜之民，上負陛下，下負所學，乞解罷政權，避賢路。

translations.literal: Your subject cannot make all under Heaven Yao-Shun's people — failing Your Majesty above, failing what he studied below — I beg to resign governmental power and yield the path to the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject cannot make all under Heaven the people of Yao and Shun — failing Your Majesty above, failing what I studied below — I beg to resign governmental power and yield the path to the worthy.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「朕在位，必卿在中書，朕與卿相與終始，自今其勿復言。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "While We hold the throne, you must be in the Secretariat — We and you from beginning to end; from now do not speak of this again.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "While I hold the throne, you must remain in the Secretariat — you and I from beginning to end. From now on do not speak of this again.

sentences.zh: 」繼賜爵秦國公，帝親授以印章，命學士院降制。

translations.literal: " He then enfeoffed him as Duke of Qin; the Emperor personally handed him the seal and ordered the Academy of Letters to issue the patent.
translations.idiomatic: He then enfeoffed him as Duke of Qin. The emperor personally handed him the seal and ordered the Academy of Letters to issue the patent.

sentences.zh: 又圖其像，敕詞臣為之贊，及御書「秋穀」二字，識以璽而賜之。

translations.literal: Again his portrait was painted; he ordered literary ministers to compose its encomium, and personally wrote the two characters "Autumn Grain," stamped with the seal and granted.
translations.idiomatic: Again his portrait was painted. The emperor ordered literary ministers to compose its encomium, and personally wrote the two characters "Autumn Grain," stamped them with the seal, and granted them.

sentences.zh: 入見，必賜坐，語移時，稱其字而不名，其見尊禮如此。

translations.literal: On entering audience he was always granted a seat; conversation lasted long; he was called by his style name and not by name — such was the honor shown him.
translations.idiomatic: On entering audience he was always granted a seat. Conversation lasted long. He was called by his style name and not by name — such was the honor shown him.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗語近臣曰：「道復以道德相朕，致天下蒙澤。

translations.literal: The Emperor once said to palace favorites: "Daofu with virtue and the Way assists Us, causing all under Heaven to receive grace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once said to palace favorites, "Daofu assists me with virtue and the Way, causing all under Heaven to receive grace.

sentences.zh: 」賜之鈔十萬貫，令將作為治第。

translations.literal: " He granted him one hundred thousand strings of paper money and ordered the Directorate of Palace Construction to build him a residence.
translations.idiomatic: He granted him one hundred thousand strings of paper money and ordered the Directorate of Palace Construction to build him a residence.

sentences.zh: 孟辭曰：「臣布衣際遇，所望於陛下者，非富貴之謂也。

translations.literal: Meng declined saying: "Your subject, a commoner favored — what he hoped from Your Majesty was not wealth and honor.
translations.idiomatic: Meng declined, saying, "Your subject, a commoner favored — what I hoped from Your Majesty was not wealth and honor.

sentences.zh: 」悉辭不受。

translations.literal: " He entirely declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: He entirely declined and did not accept.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年正月，授翰林學士承旨、知制誥兼修國史，仍平章政事。

translations.literal: In the first month of Huangqing 1 he was appointed Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin, Drafter of Edicts, Compiler of National History, and still Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Huangqing 1 he was appointed Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin, Drafter of Edicts, Compiler of National History, and still Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 未幾，請告歸葬其父母，帝勞餞之曰：「事訖，宜速還，毋久留，孤朕所望！

translations.literal: Before long he requested leave to return and bury his parents; the Emperor saw him off with labor saying: "When the affair is finished, you should quickly return — do not stay long and leave Us lonely in what We hope!
translations.idiomatic: Before long he requested leave to return and bury his parents. The emperor saw him off with warm words, saying, "When the affair is finished, you should quickly return — do not stay long and leave me lonely in what I hope!

sentences.zh: 」十二月，入朝，帝大悅，慰勞甚至，因請謝事，優詔不允；

translations.literal: " In the twelfth month he entered court; the Emperor was greatly pleased and consoled him exceedingly; he then requested to resign affairs — a gracious edict did not permit;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he entered court. The emperor was greatly pleased and consoled him exceedingly. He then requested to resign affairs — a gracious edict did not permit it;

sentences.zh: 請益堅，乃命以平章政事議中書省事，承旨翰林。

translations.literal: he requested more firmly — then he was ordered to deliberate Secretariat affairs as Grand Councilor and serve as Hanlin Expositor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: he requested more firmly — then he was ordered to deliberate Secretariat affairs as Grand Councilor and serve as Hanlin Expositor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 二年夏，乞還國公印，奏三上，始如所請。

translations.literal: In summer of the second year he begged to return the Duke's seal; memorializing three times, at last his request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In summer of the second year he begged to return the Duke's seal. Memorializing three times, at last his request was granted.

sentences.zh: 帝每與孟論用人之方，孟曰：「人材所出，固非一途，然漢、唐、宋、金，科舉得人為盛。

translations.literal: The Emperor often discussed with Meng the method of employing men; Meng said: "The sources of human talent are naturally not of one path, yet Han, Tang, Song, and Jin — through the civil service examinations they obtained men in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor often discussed with Meng the method of employing men. Meng said, "The sources of human talent are naturally not of one path, yet Han, Tang, Song, and Jin — through the civil service examinations they obtained men in abundance.

sentences.zh: 今欲興天下之賢能，如以科舉取之，猶勝於多門而進；

translations.literal: Now wishing to raise the worthy and able under Heaven, if taken through the civil service examinations, it is still better than advancement through many gates;
translations.idiomatic: Now, wishing to raise the worthy and able under Heaven, if taken through the civil service examinations, it is still better than advancement through many gates;

sentences.zh: 然必先德行經術而後文辭，乃可得真材也。

translations.literal: yet virtue, conduct, and classical learning must come first, then literary composition — only then can true talent be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: yet virtue, conduct, and classical learning must come first, then literary composition — only then can true talent be obtained.

sentences.zh: 」帝深然其言，決意行之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor deeply approved his words and resolved to carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply approved his words and resolved to carry it out.

sentences.zh: 延祐元年十二月，復拜平章政事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of Yanyou 1 he was again appointed Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Yanyou 1 he was again appointed Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 二年春，命知貢舉，及廷策進士，為監試官。

translations.literal: In spring of the second year he was ordered to supervise the examinations, and at the palace examination for jinshi he served as supervising examiner.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year he was ordered to supervise the examinations, and at the palace examination for jinshi he served as supervising examiner.

sentences.zh: 七月，進金紫光祿大夫、上柱國，改封韓國公，職任如故。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he was promoted to Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Cord, Pillar of the State, and enfeoffed as Duke of Han — his duties remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was promoted to Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Cord, Pillar of the State, and enfeoffed as Duke of Han — his duties remained as before.

sentences.zh: 已而以衰病不任事，乞解政權歸田裡，帝不得已從所請，復為翰林學士承旨，入侍宴間，禮遇尤厚。

translations.literal: Later, because of decline and illness he could not bear affairs, he begged to resign governmental power and return to the fields; the Emperor had no choice but to grant his request, and again made him Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief; attending banquets, his courtesy was especially thick.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because of decline and illness he could not bear affairs, he begged to resign governmental power and return to the fields. The emperor had no choice but to grant his request and again made him Hanlin Academician Expositor-in-Chief. Attending banquets, his courtesy was especially thick.

sentences.zh: 延祐七年，仁宗崩，英宗初立，太師鐵木迭兒復相，以孟前共政時不附己，讒構誣謗，盡收前後封拜制命，降授集賢侍講學士、嘉議大夫，度其必辭，因中害之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yanyou Renzong died; when Yingzong first ascended, Grand Preceptor Temuder again became chief minister; because Meng when they shared government before did not attach to him, he slandered and framed him, collected all patents of enfeoffment and appointment before and after, and demoted him to Academician Lecturer of the Hall of Gathered Worthies and Grand Master for Honorable Discussion — calculating that he would surely decline, and thereby harmed him in the middle.
translations.idiomatic: In Yanyou 7 Renzong died. When Yingzong first ascended, Grand Preceptor Temuder again became chief minister. Because Meng when they shared government before did not attach to him, he slandered and framed him, collected all patents of enfeoffment and appointment before and after, and demoted him to Academician Lecturer of the Hall of Gathered Worthies and Grand Master for Honorable Discussion — calculating that he would surely decline, and thereby harmed him in the middle.

sentences.zh: 孟拜命欣然，適翰林學士劉賡來慰問，即與同入院。

translations.literal: Meng accepted the appointment gladly; just as Hanlin Academician Liu Geng came to console him, he entered the academy with him.
translations.idiomatic: Meng accepted the appointment gladly. Just as Hanlin Academician Liu Geng came to console him, he entered the academy with him.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使以聞曰：「李孟今日供職，舊例當賜酒。

translations.literal: The Director of the Xuanzheng Court reported: "Li Meng today takes up his post — by old custom wine should be granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of the Xuanzheng Court reported, "Li Meng today takes up his post — by old custom wine should be granted.

sentences.zh: 」帝愕然曰：「李道复乃肯俯就集賢耶？

translations.literal: " The Emperor was startled and said: "Li Daofu is willing to humble himself to accept the Hall of Gathered Worthies?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was startled and said, "Li Daofu is willing to humble himself to accept the Hall of Gathered Worthies?

sentences.zh: 」時鐵木迭兒子八爾吉思侍帝側，帝顧謂曰：「爾輩謂彼不肯為是官，今定何如！

translations.literal: " At the time Temuder's son Barchins was attending the Emperor's side; the Emperor turned and said: "You said he would not accept this office — now how is it!
translations.idiomatic: At the time Temuder's son Barchins was attending the emperor's side. The emperor turned and said, "You said he would not accept this office — now how is it!

sentences.zh: 」由是讒不得行。

translations.literal: " Thereby the slander could not proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby the slander could not proceed.

sentences.zh: 嘗語人曰：「老臣待罪中書，無補於國，聖恩寬宥，不奪其祿，今老矣，其何以報稱！

translations.literal: Once he said to others: "This old minister awaited punishment in the Secretariat, without benefit to the state; the sage grace pardoned and did not take his salary — now I am old, how can I repay it!
translations.idiomatic: Once he said to others, "This old minister awaited punishment in the Secretariat, without benefit to the state. The sage grace pardoned and did not take my salary — now I am old, how can I repay it!

sentences.zh: 」帝聞而善之，恩意稍加。

translations.literal: " The Emperor heard and approved; grace and favor were slightly increased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard and approved. Grace and favor were slightly increased.

sentences.zh: 至治元年卒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizhi he died.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhizhi 1 he died.

sentences.zh: 御史累章辨其誣，詔復元官。

translations.literal: Censors repeatedly memorialized to clear the slander; an edict restored his original office.
translations.idiomatic: Censors repeatedly memorialized to clear the slander. An edict restored his original office.

sentences.zh: 至治中，贈舊學同德翊戴輔治功臣、太保、儀同三司、上柱國，追封魏國公，諡文忠。

translations.literal: In the Zhizhi period he was posthumously granted the title of Meritorious Minister of Old Learning, Shared Virtue, Assisting Support, and Governance, Grand Guardian, Three Excellencies of Equal Honor, Pillar of the State; posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Wei; posthumous title Wenzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhizhi period he was posthumously granted the title of Meritorious Minister of Old Learning, Shared Virtue, Assisting Support, and Governance, Grand Guardian, Three Excellencies of Equal Honor, and Pillar of the State; posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Wei; posthumous title Wenzong.

sentences.zh: 孟宇量閎廓，材略過人，三入中書，民間利害，知無不言，引古證今，務歸至當。

translations.literal: Meng's capacity and measure were broad and spacious, his talent and strategy surpassing others; three times entering the Secretariat, on the people's profit and harm he knew nothing he did not speak; citing antiquity to prove the present, he strove to reach what was most fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Meng's capacity and measure were broad and spacious, his talent and strategy surpassing others. Three times entering the Secretariat, on the people's profit and harm he knew nothing he did not speak. Citing antiquity to prove the present, he strove to reach what was most fitting.

sentences.zh: 士無貴賤，苟賢矣，不進拔不已。

translations.literal: For scholars, noble or base — if they were worthy, he did not stop advancing and elevating them.
translations.idiomatic: For scholars, noble or base — if they were worthy, he did not stop advancing and elevating them.

sentences.zh: 遊其門者，後皆知名。

translations.literal: Those who visited his gate afterward all became famous.
translations.idiomatic: Those who visited his gate afterward all became famous.

sentences.zh: 退居一室，蕭然如布衣。

translations.literal: Retiring to one room, he was austere as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Retiring to one room, he lived as austere as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 為文有奇氣，其論必主於理，其獻納謀議，常自毀其稿，家無幾存。

translations.literal: In writing he had a strange vigor; his discourse always took principle as master; his memorials and counsel he often destroyed the drafts himself — the family has scarcely any preserved.
translations.idiomatic: In writing he had a strange vigor. His discourse always took principle as master. His memorials and counsel he often destroyed the drafts himself — the family has scarcely any preserved.

sentences.zh: 皇慶、延祐之世，每一政之繆，人必以為鐵木迭兒所為；

translations.literal: In the Huangqing and Yanyou periods, whenever a policy was wrong, people were sure to say Temuder did it;
translations.idiomatic: In the Huangqing and Yanyou periods, whenever a policy was wrong, people were sure to say Temuder did it;

sentences.zh: 一令之善，必歸之於孟焉。

translations.literal: whenever an order was good, it was sure to be attributed to Meng.
translations.idiomatic: whenever an order was good, it was sure to be attributed to Meng.

sentences.zh: 子獻，御史中丞、同知經筵事。

translations.literal: His son Xian was Censor-in-Chief and Associate Director of Classics Lecture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xian was Censor-in-Chief and Associate Director of Classics Lecture affairs.

sentences.zh: ○張養浩

translations.literal: Zhang Yanghao
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanghao

sentences.zh: 張養浩，字希孟，濟南人。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanghao, style name Ximeng, was a man of Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanghao, courtesy name Ximeng, was a native of Jinan.

sentences.zh: 幼有行義，嘗出，遇人有遺楮幣於途者，其人已去，追而還之。

translations.literal: In youth he had conduct and righteousness; once going out he met someone who had dropped paper money on the road; the man had already gone — he pursued and returned it.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he had conduct and righteousness. Once going out he met someone who had dropped paper money on the road. The man had already gone — he pursued and returned it.

sentences.zh: 年方十歲，讀書不輟，父母憂其過勤而止之，養浩晝則默誦，夜則閉戶，張燈竊讀。

translations.literal: At just ten years he read without stopping; his parents worried he was too diligent and stopped him — Yanghao by day silently recited, by night closed the door, lit a lamp and read in secret.
translations.idiomatic: At just ten he read without stopping. His parents worried he was too diligent and stopped him — Yanghao by day silently recited, by night closed the door, lit a lamp, and read in secret.

sentences.zh: 山東按察使焦遂聞之，薦為東平學正。

translations.literal: Shandong Surveillance Commissioner Jiao Sui heard of this and recommended him as Director of Studies at Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong Surveillance Commissioner Jiao Sui heard of this and recommended him as Director of Studies at Dongping.

sentences.zh: 遊京師，獻書於平章不忽木，大奇之，辟為禮部令史，仍薦入御史臺。

translations.literal: Traveling to the capital he presented a book to Grand Councilor Buqa — greatly astonished, Buqa recruited him as clerk of the Ministry of Rites and still recommended him into the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling to the capital he presented a book to Grand Councilor Buqa — greatly astonished, Buqa recruited him as clerk of the Ministry of Rites and still recommended him into the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 一日病，不忽木親至其家問疾，四顧壁立，歎曰：「此真台掾也。

translations.literal: One day ill, Buqa personally came to his home to ask after his illness; looking around, the walls were bare — he sighed and said: "This is truly a censorate clerk.
translations.idiomatic: One day ill, Buqa personally came to his home to ask after his illness. Looking around, the walls were bare — he sighed and said, "This is truly a censorate clerk.

sentences.zh: 」及為丞相掾，選授堂邑縣尹。

translations.literal: " When he became a chief minister's clerk he was selected and appointed magistrate of Tangyi County.
translations.idiomatic: When he became a chief minister's clerk he was selected and appointed magistrate of Tangyi County.

sentences.zh: 人言官捨不利，居無免者，竟居之。

translations.literal: People said the official residence was unlucky — those who lived there were not spared; he ultimately lived there.
translations.idiomatic: People said the official residence was unlucky — those who lived there were not spared. He ultimately lived there.

sentences.zh: 首毀淫祠三十餘所，罷舊盜之朔望參者，曰：「彼皆良民，飢寒所迫，不得已而為盜耳；

translations.literal: First he destroyed more than thirty licentious shrines and stopped the old custom of having former thieves attend on the first and fifteenth; he said: "They are all good people, forced by hunger and cold — having no choice they became thieves;
translations.idiomatic: First he destroyed more than thirty licentious shrines and stopped the old custom of having former thieves attend on the first and fifteenth of the month. He said, "They are all good people, forced by hunger and cold — having no choice they became thieves;

sentences.zh: 既加之以刑，猶以盜目之，是絕其自新之路也。

translations.literal: having already added punishment, yet still to mark them as thieves — this cuts off the path of self-renewal.
translations.idiomatic: having already added punishment, yet still to mark them as thieves — this cuts off the path of self-renewal.

sentences.zh: 」眾盜感泣，互相戒曰：「毋負張公。

translations.literal: " All the thieves were moved to tears and mutually warned: "Do not fail Lord Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: All the thieves were moved to tears and mutually warned one another, "Do not fail Lord Zhang.

sentences.zh: 」有李虎者，嘗殺人，其黨暴戾為害，民不堪命，舊尹莫敢詰問。

translations.literal: " There was one Li Hu who had once killed a man; his gang was violent and harmful — the people could not bear their lives; former magistrates dared not question them.
translations.idiomatic: There was one Li Hu who had once killed a man. His gang was violent and harmful — the people could not bear their lives. Former magistrates dared not question them.

sentences.zh: 養浩至，盡置諸法，民甚快之。

translations.literal: When Yanghao arrived he fully applied the law — the people were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: When Yanghao arrived he fully applied the law — the people were greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 去官十年，猶為立碑頌德。

translations.literal: Ten years after he left office they still erected a stele praising his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Ten years after he left office they still erected a stele praising his virtue.

sentences.zh: 仁宗在東宮，召為司經，未至，改文學，拜監察御史。

translations.literal: When Renzong was in the Eastern Palace he was summoned as Director of Classics — before he arrived it was changed to Literary Studies; he was appointed Surveillance Censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong was in the Eastern Palace he was summoned as Director of Classics — before he arrived it was changed to Literary Studies. He was appointed Surveillance Censor.

sentences.zh: 初，議立尚書省，養浩言其不便；

translations.literal: At first, when the establishment of the Ministry of Revenue was discussed, Yanghao said it was inconvenient;
translations.idiomatic: At first, when the establishment of the Ministry of Revenue was discussed, Yanghao said it was inconvenient;

sentences.zh: 既立，又言變法亂政，將禍天下。

translations.literal: once established, he again said changing laws disturbed government and would bring disaster on all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: once established, he again said changing laws disturbed government and would bring disaster on all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 台臣抑而不聞，乃揚言曰：「昔桑哥用事，台臣不言，後幾不免。

translations.literal: Censorate members suppressed it and did not report; he then proclaimed publicly: "Formerly when Sangge held power the censorate did not speak — afterward they nearly could not escape.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate members suppressed it and did not report. He then proclaimed publicly, "Formerly when Sangge held power the censorate did not speak — afterward they nearly could not escape.

sentences.zh: 今御史既言，又不以聞，台將安用！

translations.literal: Now the censor has spoken yet it is not reported — of what use is the censorate!
translations.idiomatic: Now the censor has spoken yet it is not reported — of what use is the censorate!

sentences.zh: 」時武宗將親祀南郊，不豫，遣大臣代祀，風忽大起，人多凍死。

translations.literal: " At the time Wuzong was about to personally sacrifice at the Southern Altar; unwell, he sent a great minister to sacrifice in his place — wind suddenly rose greatly and many people froze to death.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Wuzong was about to personally sacrifice at the Southern Altar. Unwell, he sent a great minister to sacrifice in his place — wind suddenly rose greatly and many people froze to death.

sentences.zh: 養浩於祀所揚言曰：「代祀非人，故天示之變。

translations.literal: Yanghao at the sacrifice site proclaimed publicly: "Substitute sacrifice was not a man — therefore Heaven showed the change.
translations.idiomatic: Yanghao at the sacrifice site proclaimed publicly, "The substitute sacrifice was not the right man — therefore Heaven showed the change.

sentences.zh: 」大違時相意。

translations.literal: " Greatly contrary to the chief minister's intent.
translations.idiomatic: This greatly contradicted the chief minister's intent.

sentences.zh: 時省臣奏用台臣，養浩歎曰：「尉專捕盜，縱不稱職，使盜自選可乎？

translations.literal: At the time provincial ministers memorialized to employ censorate members; Yanghao sighed and said: "The constable specially catches thieves — if he is not fit for the post, should thieves be allowed to choose themselves?
translations.idiomatic: At the time provincial ministers memorialized to employ censorate members. Yanghao sighed and said, "The constable specially catches thieves — if he is not fit for the post, should thieves be allowed to choose themselves?

sentences.zh: 」遂疏時政萬餘言：一曰賞賜太侈，二曰刑禁太疏，三曰名爵太輕，四曰台綱太弱，五曰土木太盛，六曰號令太浮，七曰幸門太多，八曰風俗太靡，九曰異端太橫，十曰取相之術太寬。

translations.literal: " He then memorialized on current government in more than ten thousand words: first, rewards and gifts too extravagant; second, punishments and prohibitions too loose; third, titles and ranks too lightly given; fourth, the censorate's authority too weak; fifth, earthworks and timber too excessive; sixth, orders and commands too floating; seventh, the gate of favor too many; eighth, customs too extravagant; ninth, heterodox teachings too overbearing; tenth, the method of selecting chief ministers too broad.
translations.idiomatic: He then memorialized on current government in more than ten thousand words: first, rewards and gifts too extravagant; second, punishments and prohibitions too loose; third, titles and ranks too lightly given; fourth, the censorate's authority too weak; fifth, earthworks and timber too excessive; sixth, orders and commands too hollow; seventh, the gate of favor too wide; eighth, customs too extravagant; ninth, heterodox teachings too overbearing; tenth, the method of selecting chief ministers too broad.

sentences.zh: 言皆切直，當國者不能容。

translations.literal: His words were all cutting and straight; those holding the state could not tolerate him.
translations.idiomatic: His words were all cutting and straight. Those holding the state could not tolerate him.

sentences.zh: 遂除翰林待制，复構以罪罷之，戒省台勿復用。

translations.literal: He was then removed to Hanlin Awaiting Draftsman; again framed with a crime and dismissed; the provincial offices and censorate were warned not to employ him again.
translations.idiomatic: He was then removed to Hanlin Awaiting Draftsman. Again framed with a crime and dismissed, the provincial offices and censorate were warned not to employ him again.

sentences.zh: 養浩恐及禍，乃變姓名遁去。

translations.literal: Yanghao feared reaching disaster and changed his name and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yanghao feared reaching disaster and changed his name and fled.
