sentences.zh: 尚書省罷，始召為右司都事。

translations.literal: When the Ministry of Revenue was abolished he was first summoned as Right Section Chief Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ministry of Revenue was abolished he was first summoned as Right Section Chief Administrator.

sentences.zh: 在堂邑時，其縣達魯花赤嘗與之有隙，時方求選，養浩為白宰相，授以美職。

translations.literal: When at Tangyi, the county's darughachi had once had a grudge with him; at the time he was seeking selection — Yanghao spoke for him to the chief minister and he was granted a fine post.
translations.idiomatic: When at Tangyi, the county's darughachi had once had a grudge with him. At the time he was seeking selection — Yanghao spoke for him to the chief minister and he was granted a fine post.

sentences.zh: 遷翰林直學士，改秘書少監。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hanlin Direct Academician and changed to Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Hanlin Direct Academician and changed to Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 延祐初，設進士科，遂以禮部侍郎知貢舉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yanyou the jinshi examination was established; he was therefore made Vice Minister of Rites supervising the examinations.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yanyou the jinshi examination was established. He was therefore made Vice Minister of Rites supervising the examinations.

sentences.zh: 進士詣謁，皆不納，但使人戒之曰：「諸君子但思報效，奚勞謝為！

translations.literal: Jinshi who came to pay respects — he would none of them receive, but only sent someone to warn them: "Gentlemen, only think of repaying service — why trouble with thanks!
translations.idiomatic: Jinshi who came to pay their respects — he would receive none of them, but only sent someone to warn them, "Gentlemen, only think of repaying service — why trouble with thanks!

sentences.zh: 」擢陝西行台治書侍御史，改右司郎中，拜禮部尚書。

translations.literal: " He was promoted to Supervising Censor of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, changed to Right Section Chief Administrator, and appointed Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Supervising Censor of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate, changed to Right Section Chief Administrator, and appointed Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 英宗即位，命參議中書省事，會元夕，帝欲於內庭張燈為鰲山，即上疏於左丞相拜住。

translations.literal: When Yingzong ascended he was ordered to Deliberate Secretariat Affairs; on the Lantern Festival the Emperor wished to hang lanterns in the inner court to make a turtle mountain — he immediately memorialized the Left Grand Councilor Baizhu.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingzong ascended he was ordered to Deliberate Secretariat Affairs. On the Lantern Festival the emperor wished to hang lanterns in the inner court to make a turtle mountain — he immediately memorialized the Left Grand Councilor Baizhu.

sentences.zh: 拜住袖其疏入諫，其略曰：「世祖臨御三十餘年，每值元夕，閭閻之間，燈火亦禁；

translations.literal: Baizhu put the memorial in his sleeve and entered to remonstrate; the gist was: "Shizu held the throne more than thirty years; each time at the Lantern Festival, even among lanes and alleys, lamps were forbidden;
translations.idiomatic: Baizhu put the memorial in his sleeve and entered to remonstrate. The gist was, "Shizu held the throne more than thirty years. Each Lantern Festival, even among lanes and alleys, lamps were forbidden;

sentences.zh: 況闕庭之嚴，宮掖之邃，尤當戒慎。

translations.literal: how much more the solemnity of the palace gate and the depth of the inner palace — one should especially guard and be cautious.
translations.idiomatic: how much more the solemnity of the palace gate and the depth of the inner palace — one should especially guard and be cautious.

sentences.zh: 今燈山之構，臣以為所玩者小，所繫者大；

translations.literal: Now in constructing the lamp mountain, your subject thinks what is played with is small, what is bound up is great;
translations.idiomatic: Now in constructing the lamp mountain, your subject thinks what is played with is small, what is bound up is great;

sentences.zh: 所樂者淺，所患者深。

translations.literal: what is enjoyed is shallow, what is harmed is deep.
translations.idiomatic: what is enjoyed is shallow, what is harmed is deep.

sentences.zh: 伏願以崇儉慮遠為法，以喜奢樂近為戒。

translations.literal: I humbly wish to take honoring frugality and considering the distant as law, and taking delight in extravagance and clinging to the near as warning.
translations.idiomatic: I humbly wish to take honoring frugality and considering the distant as law, and taking delight in extravagance and clinging to the near as warning.

sentences.zh: 」帝大怒，既覽而喜曰：「非張希孟不敢言。

translations.literal: " The Emperor was greatly angered; having read it he was pleased and said: "Only Zhang Ximeng would dare speak.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly angered. Having read it he was pleased and said, "Only Zhang Ximeng would dare speak.

sentences.zh: 」即罷之，仍賜尚服金織幣一、帛一，以旌其直。

translations.literal: " He immediately stopped it, and still granted one piece of imperial gold brocade and one piece of silk to mark his straightness.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately stopped it, and still granted one piece of imperial gold brocade and one piece of silk to mark his straightness.

sentences.zh: 後以父老，棄官歸養，召為吏部尚書，不拜。

translations.literal: Later because his father was old he abandoned office to return and support him; summoned as Minister of Personnel — he did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because his father was old, he abandoned office to return and support him. Summoned as Minister of Personnel — he did not accept.

sentences.zh: 丁父憂，未終喪，復以吏部尚書召，力辭不起。

translations.literal: When his father's mourning ended before mourning was finished, again summoned as Minister of Personnel — he firmly declined and did not rise.
translations.idiomatic: When his father died, before mourning was finished he was again summoned as Minister of Personnel — he firmly declined and did not rise.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年，以太子詹事丞兼經筵說書召，又辭；

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiding he was summoned as Associate Director of the Crown Prince's Household and Classics Lecturer — again he declined;
translations.idiomatic: In Taiding 1 he was summoned as Associate Director of the Crown Prince's Household and Classics Lecturer — again he declined;

sentences.zh: 改淮東廉訪使，進翰林學士，皆不赴。

translations.literal: changed to Huaidong Surveillance Commissioner, promoted to Hanlin Academician — all he did not go to.
translations.idiomatic: changed to Huaidong Surveillance Commissioner, promoted to Hanlin Academician — all he did not accept.

sentences.zh: 天歷二年，關中大旱，饑民相食，特拜陝西行台中丞。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianli, Guanzhong suffered great drought; starving people ate one another — he was specially appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianli 2, Guanzhong suffered great drought. Starving people ate one another — he was specially appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 既聞命，即散其家之所有與鄉里貧乏者，登車就道，遇餓者則賑之，死者則葬之。

translations.literal: As soon as he heard the order he distributed all his household possessions to the poor in his village, mounted his carriage and set out on the road; meeting the starving he relieved them, meeting the dead he buried them.
translations.idiomatic: As soon as he heard the order he distributed all his household possessions to the poor in his village, mounted his carriage and set out on the road. Meeting the starving he relieved them; meeting the dead he buried them.

sentences.zh: 道經華山，禱雨於岳祠，泣拜不能起，天忽陰翳，一雨二日。

translations.literal: Passing Mount Hua he prayed for rain at the mountain shrine; weeping and bowing he could not rise — Heaven suddenly clouded over and rain fell for two days.
translations.idiomatic: Passing Mount Hua he prayed for rain at the mountain shrine. Weeping and bowing he could not rise — Heaven suddenly clouded over and rain fell for two days.

sentences.zh: 及到官，复禱於社壇，大雨如注，水三尺乃止，禾黍自生，秦人大喜。

translations.literal: On reaching his post he again prayed at the altar of the soil; great rain poured like pouring water, stopping when the water was three feet deep — millet and grain sprouted by themselves; the people of Qin were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching his post he again prayed at the altar of the soil. Great rain poured down, stopping when the water was three feet deep — millet and grain sprouted by themselves, and the people of Qin were greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 時斗米直十三緡，民持鈔出糶，稍昏即不用，詣庫換易，則豪猾黨蔽，易十與五，累日不可得，民大困。

translations.literal: At the time a dou of rice cost thirteen strings; people took paper money out to sell grain — slightly darkened it was not used; going to the treasury to exchange, powerful scoundrels blocked it, exchanging ten for five — many days could not obtain it; the people were greatly distressed.
translations.idiomatic: At the time a dou of rice cost thirteen strings. People took paper money out to sell grain — slightly darkened notes were not accepted. Going to the treasury to exchange, powerful scoundrels blocked them, exchanging ten for five — for many days they could obtain nothing. The people were greatly distressed.

sentences.zh: 乃檢庫中未毀昏鈔文可驗者，得一千八十五萬五千餘緡，悉以印記其背，又刻十貫、伍貫為券，給散貧乏，命米商視印記出糶，詣庫驗數以易之，於是吏弊不敢行。

translations.literal: He then inspected the treasury for undestroyed dark notes whose text could be verified — obtaining more than ten million eight hundred fifty-five thousand strings; all were stamped on the back, and ten-string and five-string notes were carved as certificates, distributed to the poor; grain merchants were ordered to sell grain viewing the stamp, going to the treasury to verify the number and exchange — thereby clerical abuses dared not proceed.
translations.idiomatic: He then inspected the treasury for undestroyed dark notes whose text could be verified — obtaining more than ten million eight hundred fifty-five thousand strings. All were stamped on the back, and ten-string and five-string notes were carved as certificates and distributed to the poor. Grain merchants were ordered to sell grain viewing the stamp and go to the treasury to verify the number and exchange — thereby clerical abuses dared not proceed.

sentences.zh: 又率富民出粟，因上章請行納粟補官之令。

translations.literal: Again he led wealthy households to give grain, and memorialized requesting the order to accept grain in exchange for office.
translations.idiomatic: Again he led wealthy households to give grain and memorialized requesting the order to accept grain in exchange for office.

sentences.zh: 聞民間有殺子以奉母者，為之大慟，出私錢以濟之。

translations.literal: Hearing that among the people there was one who killed his son to support his mother, he greatly wailed for it and gave private money to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that among the people there was one who killed his son to support his mother, he greatly wailed for it and gave private money to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 到官四月，未嘗家居，止宿公署，夜則禱於天，晝則出賑饑民，終日無少怠。

translations.literal: Four months after reaching his post he never lived at home — only lodging in the public office; by night he prayed to Heaven, by day he went out to relieve starving people — all day without the slightest slackening.
translations.idiomatic: Four months after reaching his post he never lived at home — only lodging in the public office. By night he prayed to Heaven; by day he went out to relieve starving people — all day without the slightest slackening.

sentences.zh: 每一念至，即撫膺痛哭，遂得疾不起，卒年六十。

translations.literal: Whenever the thought came he beat his breast and wept bitterly — he then fell ill and did not rise; he died at age sixty.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the thought came he beat his breast and wept bitterly — he then fell ill and did not rise. He died at age sixty.

sentences.zh: 關中之人，哀之如失父母。

translations.literal: The people of Guanzhong mourned him as if losing parents.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Guanzhong mourned him as if losing parents.

sentences.zh: 至順二年，贈據誠宣惠功臣、榮祿大夫、陝西等處行中書省平章政事、柱國，追封濱國公，諡文忠。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhishun he was posthumously granted the title of Meritorious Minister of Sincere Intent and Propagating Grace, Grand Master for Glorious Blessing, Grand Councilor of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat and other places, Pillar of the State; posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Bin; posthumous title Wenzong.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhishun 2 he was posthumously granted the title of Meritorious Minister of Sincere Intent and Propagating Grace, Grand Master for Glorious Blessing, Grand Councilor of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat and other places, and Pillar of the State; posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Bin; posthumous title Wenzong.

sentences.zh: 二子：彊、引，彊先卒。

translations.literal: Two sons: Qiang and Yin — Qiang died first.
translations.idiomatic: Two sons: Qiang and Yin — Qiang died first.

sentences.zh: ○敬儼

translations.literal: Jing Yan
translations.idiomatic: Jing Yan

sentences.zh: 敬儼，字威卿，其先河東人，後徙易水。

translations.literal: Jing Yan, style name Weiqing — his ancestors were men of Hedong, later moved to Yishui.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Yan, courtesy name Weiqing — his ancestors were men of Hedong, later moved to Yishui.

sentences.zh: 五世祖嗣徽，仕金，官至參知政事；

translations.literal: His fifth-generation ancestor Sihui served the Jin, reaching Associate Administrator of Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: His fifth-generation ancestor Sihui served the Jin, reaching Associate Administrator of Affairs;

sentences.zh: 曾祖子淵，樂陵令；

translations.literal: his great-grandfather Ziyuan was magistrate of Leling;
translations.idiomatic: his great-grandfather Ziyuan was magistrate of Leling;

sentences.zh: 祖鑑，同知嵩州事。

translations.literal: his grandfather Jian was Associate Administrator of Song Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: his grandfather Jian was Associate Administrator of Song Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 皆以進士起家。

translations.literal: All began their careers as jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: All began their careers as jinshi.

sentences.zh: 父元長，有學行，官至太常博士。

translations.literal: His father Yuanchang had learning and conduct, reaching Court Doctor of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yuanchang had learning and conduct, reaching Court Doctor of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 儼其仲子也，幼不為嬉戲事，長嗜學，善屬文，御史中丞郭良弼薦為殿中知班，著憲章若干卷。

translations.literal: Yan was his second son; in youth he did not engage in play; grown he loved learning and was skilled at literary composition; Censor-in-Chief Guo Liangbi recommended him as Palace Duty Officer; he compiled several fascicles of statutes.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was his second son. In youth he did not engage in play. Grown, he loved learning and was skilled at literary composition. Censor-in-Chief Guo Liangbi recommended him as Palace Duty Officer, and he compiled several fascicles of statutes.

sentences.zh: 受知於廣平王月呂祿那演，連辟太傅、太師兩府掾，調高郵縣尹，未赴，選充中書省掾。

translations.literal: He received recognition from Prince of Guangping Yelu Lüna Yan, repeatedly recruited as clerk of the Grand Tutor and Grand Preceptor offices; transferred to magistrate of Gaoyou — before he went he was selected to fill a clerkship in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He received recognition from Prince of Guangping Yelu Lüna Yan, repeatedly recruited as clerk of the Grand Tutor and Grand Preceptor offices. Transferred to magistrate of Gaoyou — before he went he was selected to fill a clerkship in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 硃清、張瑄為海運萬戶，豪縱不法，適儼典其文牘，嘗致厚賂，儼怒拒之，二人以罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan were maritime transport wanhu, arrogant and unrestrained and unlawful; Yan happened to manage their documents; they once offered thick bribes — Yan angrily refused them; the two were executed for their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan were maritime transport wanhu, arrogant, unrestrained, and unlawful. Yan happened to manage their documents. They once offered thick bribes — Yan angrily refused them. The two were executed for their crimes.

sentences.zh: 權貴多以賄敗連坐，獨儼不與。

translations.literal: Many powerful men were implicated in bribery failures — only Yan was not involved.
translations.idiomatic: Many powerful men were implicated in bribery failures — only Yan was not involved.

sentences.zh: 大德二年，授吏部主事，改集賢司直。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dade he was appointed Chief of the Ministry of Personnel, changed to Direct Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 2 he was appointed Chief of the Ministry of Personnel, changed to Direct Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies.

sentences.zh: 會湖湘有警，丞相哈剌合孫答剌罕奏儼奉詔恤民，且觀釁，甚稱旨意。

translations.literal: When there was alarm in Hunan and Hubei, Chief Minister Hala Hasan Dalaqan memorialized Yan to carry edicts and comfort the people, and also observe signs of trouble — greatly fitting the imperial intent.
translations.idiomatic: When there was alarm in Hunan and Hubei, Chief Minister Hala Hasan Dalaqan memorialized Yan to carry edicts and comfort the people, and also observe signs of trouble — greatly fitting the imperial intent.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 有故郡守子，當以廕補官，繼母訴其非嫡者，儼察其誣，按之，果如所言。

translations.literal: There was a former prefect's son who should receive office by privilege; the stepmother sued that he was not the legitimate son — Yan investigated the false charge and examined it; it was indeed as she said.
translations.idiomatic: There was a former prefect's son who should receive office by privilege. The stepmother sued that he was not the legitimate son — Yan investigated the false charge and examined it. It was indeed as she said.

sentences.zh: 七年，拜監察御史。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed Surveillance Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was appointed Surveillance Censor.

sentences.zh: 時省臣有既黜而復收用者，參預官巧佞，與相比周，以黷貨撓法，即日劾去之。

translations.literal: At the time provincial ministers who had been dismissed were again employed; participating officials were crafty and fawning, banding together with them, taking bribes and disturbing the law — he impeached and removed them the same day.
translations.idiomatic: At the time provincial ministers who had been dismissed were again employed. Participating officials were crafty and fawning, banding together with them, taking bribes and disturbing the law — he impeached and removed them the same day.

sentences.zh: 江浙行省與浙西憲司交章相攻擊，事聞，命省台遣官往治之，儼與阿思蘭海牙偕行，議多不合，兩上之，朝廷是儼議。

translations.literal: The Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat and the Zhexi Surveillance Commission mutually memorialized attacks; the matter reached the throne; the provincial offices and censorate were ordered to send officials to investigate — Yan went with Aslan Haiya; their proposals mostly did not agree — both submitted upward; the court approved Yan's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat and the Zhexi Surveillance Commission mutually memorialized attacks. The matter reached the throne. The provincial offices and censorate were ordered to send officials to investigate — Yan went with Aslan Haiya. Their proposals mostly did not agree — both submitted upward, and the court approved Yan's proposal.

sentences.zh: 七月，遷中書左司都事，扈從上京。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he was transferred to Chief Administrator of the Left Section of the Secretariat, escorting the court to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was transferred to Chief Administrator of the Left Section of the Secretariat, escorting the court to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 西京賈人有以運糧供餉北邊而得官者，盜用至數十萬石，以利啗主者，匿不發，儼按征之以輸邊。

translations.literal: A merchant of the Western Capital who had obtained office by transporting grain to supply the northern border had misappropriated up to several hundred thousand shi, using profit to bribe the responsible official who concealed and did not report — Yan investigated and collected it to supply the border.
translations.idiomatic: A merchant of the Western Capital who had obtained office by transporting grain to supply the northern border had misappropriated up to several hundred thousand shi, using profit to bribe the responsible official who concealed and did not report. Yan investigated and collected it to supply the border.

sentences.zh: 九年，授吏部郎中，以父病辭。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel, declining because of his father's illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was appointed Director of the Ministry of Personnel, declining because of his father's illness.

sentences.zh: 已而父卒，既終喪，復入御史臺為都事。

translations.literal: Before long his father died; when mourning was finished he again entered the Censorate as Chief Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Before long his father died. When mourning was finished he again entered the Censorate as Chief Administrator.

sentences.zh: 中丞何某與執政有隙，省議欲核台選之當否，儼曰：「邇者省除吏千餘人，台亦當分別之邪？

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief He had a grudge with the chief ministers; the provincial offices discussed investigating whether the censorate's selections were fitting — Yan said: "Recently the provincial offices appointed more than a thousand clerks — should the censorate also distinguish them?
translations.idiomatic: Vice Censor-in-Chief He had a grudge with the chief ministers. The provincial offices discussed investigating whether the censorate's selections were fitting. Yan said, "Recently the provincial offices appointed more than a thousand clerks — should the censorate also distinguish them?

sentences.zh: 」語聞，議遂寢。

translations.literal: " When the words were heard the discussion then ceased.
translations.idiomatic: When the words were heard the discussion then ceased.

sentences.zh: 江南行御史臺與江浙省爭政，事聞，儼曰：「省台政事，風化本原，各宜盡職，顧乃以小故忿爭，而瀆上聽乎！

translations.literal: The Jiangnan Branch Censorate and the Jiang-Zhe Secretariat disputed government — the matter reached the throne; Yan said: "Provincial and censorate affairs are the root of customs and transformation — each should fully perform duty; yet over small causes they angrily dispute and profane what reaches the throne!
translations.idiomatic: The Jiangnan Branch Censorate and the Jiang-Zhe Secretariat disputed government — the matter reached the throne. Yan said, "Provincial and censorate affairs are the root of customs and transformation — each should fully perform duty. Yet over small causes they angrily dispute and profane what reaches the throne!

sentences.zh: 」建康路總管侯珪，貪縱事敗，儼亟遣官決其事，及其夤緣近幸，奏請原之，命下，已無及矣。

translations.literal: " Circuit Administrator Hou Gui of Jiankang was greedy and unrestrained; his affair failed — Yan urgently sent officials to decide the matter; before he could use connections with palace favorites and memorialize requesting pardon, the order had descended — it was already too late.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit Administrator Hou Gui of Jiankang was greedy and unrestrained. His affair failed — Yan urgently sent officials to decide the matter. Before he could use connections with palace favorites and memorialize requesting pardon, the order had descended — it was already too late.

sentences.zh: 武宗撫軍北邊，成宗升遐，宰臣有異謀者，事定，命儼預鞫問之，悉得其情。

translations.literal: Wuzong commanded armies in the north; when Chengzong ascended to Heaven the chief ministers had divergent plots — when the affair was settled Yan was ordered to participate in interrogation and fully obtained the facts.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzong commanded armies in the north. When Chengzong ascended to Heaven the chief ministers had divergent plots — when the affair was settled Yan was ordered to participate in interrogation and fully obtained the facts.

sentences.zh: 除山北廉訪副使，入為右司郎中。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Surveillance Commissioner of the Northern Mountains, entering as Right Section Director.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Surveillance Commissioner of the Northern Mountains, entering as Right Section Director.

sentences.zh: 武宗臨御，湖廣省臣有偽為警報，馳驛入奏，以圖柄用者，儼面詰之曰：「汝守方面，既有警，豈得離職，是必虛誕耳。

translations.literal: When Wuzong held the throne, a Hunan-Hubei provincial minister falsely made an alarm report and rushed by post relay to memorialize, seeking to grasp power — Yan questioned him to his face: "You guard a region — if there is alarm, how can you leave your post? This must be false.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuzong held the throne, a Hunan-Hubei provincial minister falsely made an alarm report and rushed by post relay to memorialize, seeking to grasp power. Yan questioned him to his face, "You guard a region — if there is alarm, how can you leave your post? This must be false.

sentences.zh: 」其人竟以狀露被斥。

translations.literal: " That man ultimately was exposed by the facts and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: That man was ultimately exposed by the facts and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 旱蝗為災，民多因飢為盜，有司捕治，論以真犯。

translations.literal: Drought and locusts brought disaster; many people became thieves from hunger; the responsible offices arrested and punished them, judging them as true offenders.
translations.idiomatic: Drought and locusts brought disaster. Many people became thieves from hunger. The responsible offices arrested and punished them, judging them as true offenders.

sentences.zh: 獄既上，朝議互有從違，儼曰：「民飢而盜，迫於不得已，非故為也。

translations.literal: When the cases were submitted upward, court discussion had mutual agreement and disagreement; Yan said: "People steal from hunger, forced by having no choice — not done deliberately.
translations.idiomatic: When the cases were submitted upward, court discussion had mutual agreement and disagreement. Yan said, "People steal from hunger, forced by having no choice — not done deliberately.

sentences.zh: 且死者不可復生，宜在所矜貸。

translations.literal: Moreover the dead cannot be revived — they should be treated with compassion and pardon.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the dead cannot be revived — they should be treated with compassion and pardon.

sentences.zh: 」用是得減死者甚眾。

translations.literal: " By this many who would have been executed were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: By this many who would have been executed were spared.

sentences.zh: 至大元年，授左司郎中，擢江南諸道行御史臺治書侍御史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhidai he was appointed Left Section Director and promoted to Supervising Censor of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidai 1 he was appointed Left Section Director and promoted to Supervising Censor of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.

sentences.zh: 先是，儼以議立尚書省，忤宰臣意，適兩淮鹽法久滯，乃左遷儼為轉運使，欲以陷之。

translations.literal: Previously Yan because he discussed establishing the Ministry of Revenue offended the chief ministers' intent; just as the two Huai salt law had long stagnated, Yan was demoted to Transport Commissioner — intending to trap him.
translations.idiomatic: Previously Yan, because he discussed establishing the Ministry of Revenue, offended the chief ministers' intent. Just as the two Huai salt law had long stagnated, Yan was demoted to Transport Commissioner — intending to trap him.

sentences.zh: 比至，首劾場官之貪污者，法既大行，課復增羨至二十五萬引。

translations.literal: On arriving he first impeached corrupt salt-field officials; once the law was fully enforced, revenue again increased by surplus to two hundred fifty thousand yin.
translations.idiomatic: On arriving he first impeached corrupt salt-field officials. Once the law was fully enforced, revenue again increased by surplus to two hundred fifty thousand yin.

sentences.zh: 河南行省參政來會鹽筴，將以羨數為歲入常額。

translations.literal: The Henan Branch Associate Administrator came to discuss salt policy, wishing to make the surplus number the regular annual intake.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan Branch Associate Administrator came to discuss salt policy, wishing to make the surplus number the regular annual intake.

sentences.zh: 儼以亭戶凋弊已甚，以羨為額，民力將殫，病人以為己，非宰臣事，事遂止。

translations.literal: Yan said the salt households were already extremely depleted — to make the surplus the quota would exhaust the people's strength, harming others to benefit oneself — this was not a chief minister's affair; the affair then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Yan said the salt households were already extremely depleted — to make the surplus the quota would exhaust the people's strength, harming others to benefit oneself. This was not a chief minister's affair, and the affair then stopped.

sentences.zh: 仁宗踐阼，召為戶部尚書，廷議欲革尚書省弊政，儼言：「遽罷錢不用，恐細民失利。

translations.literal: When Renzong ascended the throne he was summoned as Minister of Revenue; at court they discussed wishing to abolish the Ministry of Revenue's abusive policies; Yan said: "Suddenly abolishing paper money without use — I fear the common people will lose benefit.
translations.idiomatic: When Renzong ascended the throne he was summoned as Minister of Revenue. At court they discussed wishing to abolish the Ministry of Revenue's abusive policies. Yan said, "Suddenly abolishing paper money without use — I fear the common people will lose benefit.

sentences.zh: 」不從，以疾辭。

translations.literal: " They did not follow; he declined because of illness.
translations.idiomatic: They did not follow. He declined because of illness.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年，除浙東道廉訪使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangqing he was appointed Surveillance Commissioner of the Zhedong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 1 he was appointed Surveillance Commissioner of the Zhedong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 有錢塘退卒，詐服僧衣，稱太后旨，建婺州雙谿石橋，因大興工役以病民。

translations.literal: There was a retired soldier of Qiantang who falsely wore monk's robes, claiming the Empress Dowager's order, building the Shuangxi Stone Bridge at Wuzhou — thereby greatly raising labor to afflict the people.
translations.idiomatic: There was a retired soldier of Qiantang who falsely wore monk's robes, claiming the Empress Dowager's order, building the Shuangxi Stone Bridge at Wuzhou — thereby greatly raising labor to afflict the people.

sentences.zh: 儼命有司發其奸贓，杖遣之，仍請奏罷其役。

translations.literal: Yan ordered the responsible office to expose his wicked bribery, beat and sent him away, and still requested memorializing to stop the labor.
translations.idiomatic: Yan ordered the responsible office to expose his wicked bribery, beat and sent him away, and still requested memorializing to stop the labor.

sentences.zh: 郡大火，焚數千家，儼令發廩賑貧餒。

translations.literal: The prefecture suffered great fire, burning several thousand households — Yan ordered opening the granary to relieve the poor and hungry.
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture suffered great fire, burning several thousand households — Yan ordered opening the granary to relieve the poor and hungry.

sentences.zh: 取憲司廢堂材木及諸路學廩之羨者，建孔子廟。

translations.literal: He took timber from the surveillance commission's abandoned hall and surplus from school granaries on various circuits, and built the Confucian temple.
translations.idiomatic: He took timber from the surveillance commission's abandoned hall and surplus from school granaries on various circuits, and built the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 二年，拜江西等處行中書省參知政事。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed Associate Administrator of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was appointed Associate Administrator of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat and other places.

sentences.zh: 舊俗，民有爭，往往越訴於省，吏得併緣為奸利，訟以故繁。

translations.literal: By old custom when the people had disputes they often skipped appeal to the provincial office — clerks could combine opportunities for wicked profit; lawsuits therefore multiplied.
translations.idiomatic: By old custom when the people had disputes they often skipped appeal to the provincial office — clerks could combine opportunities for wicked profit, and lawsuits therefore multiplied.

sentences.zh: 儼令下省府，非有司，不得侵民，訟事遂簡。

translations.literal: Yan ordered sending down to provincial and prefectural offices — unless the regular office, they must not encroach on the people — lawsuit affairs then simplified.
translations.idiomatic: Yan ordered sending down to provincial and prefectorial offices — unless the regular office, they must not encroach on the people — and lawsuit affairs then simplified.

sentences.zh: 詔設科舉，儼薦臨川吳澂、金陵楊剛中為考試官，得人為多。

translations.literal: An edict established the civil service examinations; Yan recommended Linchuan Wu Cheng and Jinling Yang Gangzhong as examination officials — obtaining men in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict established the civil service examinations. Yan recommended Linchuan Wu Cheng and Jinling Yang Gangzhong as examination officials — obtaining men in abundance.

sentences.zh: 其年冬，移疾退居真州。

translations.literal: That winter he retired because of illness to live at Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he retired because of illness to live at Zhen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 除江南諸道行御史臺侍御史，不赴。

translations.literal: Appointed Attending Censor of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate — he did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed Attending Censor of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate — he did not go.

sentences.zh: 四年春，詔促就前職，以疾辭。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year an edict urged him to take his former post — he declined because of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year an edict urged him to take his former post — he declined because of illness.

sentences.zh: 七月，召為侍御史；

translations.literal: In the seventh month he was summoned as Attending Censor;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was summoned as Attending Censor;

sentences.zh: 十月，遷太子副詹事，御史大夫脫歡答剌罕奏留之，制曰「可」。

translations.literal: in the tenth month he was transferred to Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household; Censor-in-Chief Toghan Dalaqan memorialized to retain him — the patent said "Approved."
translations.idiomatic: in the tenth month he was transferred to Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household. Censor-in-Chief Toghan Dalaqan memorialized to retain him — the patent said "Approved."

sentences.zh: 湖廣省臣以贓敗，儼一日五奏，卒正其罪。

translations.literal: A Hunan-Hubei provincial minister failed from corruption — Yan memorialized five times in one day and finally corrected his crime.
translations.idiomatic: A Hunan-Hubei provincial minister failed from corruption — Yan memorialized five times in one day and finally corrected his crime.

sentences.zh: 台臣有劾去而復職者，御史复劾之，章再上，有旨命丞相、樞密共決之。

translations.literal: A censorate member who was impeached and removed was again impeached by a censor; the memorial went up twice — an edict ordered the chief minister and Bureau of Military Affairs jointly to decide.
translations.idiomatic: A censorate member who was impeached and removed was again impeached by a censor. The memorial went up twice — an edict ordered the chief minister and Bureau of Military Affairs jointly to decide.

sentences.zh: 儼曰：「如是，則台事去矣。

translations.literal: Yan said: "If so, then censorate affairs are gone.
translations.idiomatic: Yan said, "If so, then censorate affairs are gone.

sentences.zh: 」遂即帝前奏黜之，因伏殿上，叩頭請代。

translations.literal: " He then before the Emperor memorialized to dismiss him, and prostrated himself on the palace steps, knocking his head to request replacement.
translations.idiomatic: He then before the emperor memorialized to dismiss him, and prostrated himself on the palace steps, knocking his head to request replacement.

sentences.zh: 帝諭之曰：「事非由汝，汝其復位。」

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed him: "The affair is not because of you — you should resume your post."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed him, "The affair is not because of you — you should resume your post."

sentences.zh: 五年夏五月，拜中書參知政事，台臣復奏留之，儼亦陛辭，不允。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer of the fifth year he was appointed Associate Administrator of the Secretariat; censorate members again memorialized to retain him — Yan also declined at the steps; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer of the fifth year he was appointed Associate Administrator of the Secretariat. Censorate members again memorialized to retain him — Yan also declined at the steps, but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 賜《大學衍義》及所服犀帶。

translations.literal: He was granted the Extension of the Great Learning and the rhinoceros belt he wore.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the Extension of the Great Learning and the rhinoceros belt he wore.

sentences.zh: 每入見，帝以字呼之，曰威卿而不名，其見禮遇如此。

translations.literal: Each time entering audience the Emperor called him by his style name — Weiqing and not by name — such was the courtesy shown him.
translations.idiomatic: Each time entering audience the emperor called him by his style name — Weiqing and not by name — such was the courtesy shown him.

sentences.zh: 舊制，諸院及寺監，得奏除其僚屬者，歲久多冒濫，富民或以賂進，有至大官者。

translations.literal: By old system the various courts and directorates that could memorialize to appoint their subordinates — over years many were falsely usurped; wealthy commoners sometimes advanced by bribe, some reaching great office.
translations.idiomatic: By old system the various courts and directorates that could memorialize to appoint their subordinates — over years many were falsely usurped. Wealthy commoners sometimes advanced by bribe, some reaching great office.

sentences.zh: 儼以名爵當慎惜，會台臣亦以為言，乃奏請悉追奪之，遂著為令。

translations.literal: Yan because titles and ranks should be carefully cherished — just as censorate members also spoke of it — memorialized requesting all be pursued and stripped; it was then established as law.
translations.idiomatic: Yan, because titles and ranks should be carefully cherished — just as censorate members also spoke of it — memorialized requesting all be pursued and stripped, and it was then established as law.

sentences.zh: 六年，告病，賜衣一襲，遣醫視療。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he reported illness; he was granted one suit of clothing and a physician sent to treat him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he reported illness. He was granted one suit of clothing and a physician sent to treat him.

sentences.zh: 儼以其鄉在近圻，恐复徵用，乃徙居淮南，雖親故皆不接見。

translations.literal: Yan because his village was near the capital feared being summoned again — he moved to live in Huainan; even kin and old friends he did not receive.
translations.idiomatic: Yan, because his village was near the capital, feared being summoned again — he moved to live in Huainan. Even kin and old friends he did not receive.

sentences.zh: 至治元年，除陝西諸道行御史臺中丞。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizhi he was appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhizhi 1 he was appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Shaanxi Branch Censorate.

sentences.zh: 泰定元年，改江南諸道行御史臺中丞。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taiding he was changed to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiding 1 he was changed to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate.

sentences.zh: 皆不赴。

translations.literal: All he did not go to.
translations.idiomatic: All he did not accept.

sentences.zh: 年六十五，即告老，朝廷雖命其子自強為安慶總管府判官，而未從其請。

translations.literal: At age sixty-five he immediately reported old age; though the court ordered his son Ziqiang as Assistant Administrator of Anqing Circuit, yet his request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: At age sixty-five he immediately reported old age. Though the court ordered his son Ziqiang as Assistant Administrator of Anqing Circuit, yet his request was not granted.

sentences.zh: 四年春，遣使賜酒，徵為集賢大學士、榮祿大夫，商議中書省事。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year an envoy was sent granting wine, summoning him as Grand Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, Grand Master for Glorious Blessing, to Deliberate Secretariat Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year an envoy was sent granting wine, summoning him as Grand Academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, Grand Master for Glorious Blessing, to Deliberate Secretariat Affairs.

sentences.zh: 儼令使者先返，而挈家歸易水。

translations.literal: Yan ordered the envoy to return first, and taking his family returned to Yishui.
translations.idiomatic: Yan ordered the envoy to return first, and taking his family returned to Yishui.

sentences.zh: 九月，帝特署為中政院使，复賜酒，召之，乃輿疾入見，賜食慰勞，親為差吉日使視事，命朝會日無下拜；

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Emperor specially appointed him Director of the Zhongzheng Court, again granted wine and summoned him — he then came in a litter ill to audience; granted food and consoled; personally chose an auspicious day for him to assume office; ordered that on court assembly days he need not bow down;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor specially appointed him Director of the Zhongzheng Court, again granted wine and summoned him — he then came in a litter, ill, to audience. Granted food and consoled, the emperor personally chose an auspicious day for him to assume office and ordered that on court assembly days he need not bow down;

sentences.zh: 是月，拜中書平章政事，復以老病辭，不從。

translations.literal: that month he was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat; again because of old age and illness he declined — not followed.
translations.idiomatic: that month he was appointed Grand Councilor of the Secretariat. Again because of old age and illness he declined — but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 天歷改元，朝議欲盡戮朝臣之在上京者，儼抗論，謂是皆循常歲例從行，殺之非罪。

translations.literal: When the Tianli era name was changed, court discussion wished to execute all court ministers who were at the Upper Capital; Yan argued against it, saying these all followed the regular annual custom in going — to kill them was not a crime.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tianli era name was changed, court discussion wished to execute all court ministers who were at the Upper Capital. Yan argued against it, saying these all followed the regular annual custom in going — to kill them was not a crime.

sentences.zh: 眾賴之獲免。

translations.literal: The multitude relied on him to escape execution.
translations.idiomatic: The multitude relied on him to escape execution.

sentences.zh: 居月餘，傷足，告歸。

translations.literal: After just over a month he injured his foot and requested to return home.
translations.idiomatic: After just over a month he injured his foot and requested to return home.

sentences.zh: 家居十餘年，痺不能行，猶劬書不廢。

translations.literal: Living at home more than ten years, paralyzed and unable to walk, he still labored at writing without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: Living at home more than ten years, paralyzed and unable to walk, he still labored at writing without stopping.

sentences.zh: 臨終，戒子弟曰：「國恩未報，而至不祿，奈何！

translations.literal: At the end he admonished his sons and younger brothers: "The state's grace is not repaid, yet reaching untimely death — what can be done!
translations.idiomatic: At the end he admonished his sons and younger brothers, "The state's grace is not repaid, yet I reach untimely death — what can be done!

sentences.zh: 汝曹當清白守恆業，無急仕進。

translations.literal: You should keep pure and white and hold to constant livelihood — do not urgently seek office.
translations.idiomatic: You should keep pure and white and hold to constant livelihood — do not urgently seek office.

sentences.zh: 」正冠幘，端坐而逝。

translations.literal: " He straightened cap and headcloth, sat upright and passed away.
translations.idiomatic: He straightened cap and headcloth, sat upright and passed away.

sentences.zh: 贈翰林學士承旨、光祿大夫、柱國，封魯國公，諡文忠。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin, Grand Master of Brilliant Blessing, Pillar of the State; enfeoffed as Duke of Lu; posthumous title Wenzong.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously granted Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin, Grand Master of Brilliant Blessing, and Pillar of the State; enfeoffed as Duke of Lu; posthumous title Wenzong.

sentences.zh: 自強，朝散大夫、禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: Ziqiang — Grand Master for Dispersing Affairs, Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Ziqiang — Grand Master for Dispersing Affairs, Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 儼有詩文若干卷，藏於家。

translations.literal: Yan had poetry and prose in several fascicles, preserved in the family.
translations.idiomatic: Yan had poetry and prose in several fascicles, preserved in the family.

sentences.zh: 叔祖鉉，與太原元好問同登金進士第，國初為中都提學，著《春秋備忘》四十卷，仁宗朝命刻其書，今行於世。

translations.literal: His grand-uncle Xuan, with Taiyuan Yuan Haowen jointly passed the Jin jinshi examination; in the founding of the dynasty he was Chief Instructor of the Central Capital, compiled the Spring and Autumn Beiwang in forty fascicles; in Renzong's reign ordered to carve his book — now circulating in the world.
translations.idiomatic: His grand-uncle Xuan, with Taiyuan Yuan Haowen jointly passed the Jin jinshi examination. In the founding of the dynasty he was Chief Instructor of the Central Capital and compiled the Spring and Autumn Beiwang in forty fascicles. In Renzong's reign he was ordered to carve his book — now circulating in the world.
